body:
I’m not willing to sit on the sidelines in this election.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/42478?refcode=em20240110-4580&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4580%2E614464%2EjU0JZg)
Hi Peter, it’s Jon Hamm.
I’m a born-and-raised Missourian who watched with horror when Josh Hawley raised his fist at insurrectionists outside the U.S. Capitol on January 6th, then ran out the back door when they stormed the building later that day.
I’ve seen communities across my home state torn apart because of cowardly politicians like him — and I’m not willing to sit on the sidelines in this election.
So before I ask you to **[add a donation of $10 or whatever you can to my friend Lucas Kunce’s campaign to replace Josh Hawley,](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/42478?refcode=em20240110-4580&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4580%2E614464%2EjU0JZg) please let me tell you why:**
**[SUPPORT LUCAS KUNCE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/42478?refcode=em20240110-4580&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=4580%2E614464%2EjU0JZg)**
Most of my family is from a town in Missouri called Ste. Genevieve, about 60 miles south of St. Louis. I’ve watched their community go downhill for years.
While corrupt politicians shipped jobs overseas and voted to give handouts to Wall Street and their corporate allies, everyday people just trying to survive in the place they call home ran out of money and opportunities.
**Our leaders abandoned them — and Josh Hawley is the perfect example.**
Instead of fighting for what would make the communities in my home state stronger, Josh Hawley has been busy engaging in the out-of-touch culture wars that only divide us — all so he can get more and more power for himself.
That’s what we saw on January 6th, 2021. Hawley raised his fist at rioters outside the Capitol because he thought it would make himself look strong. But when sh*t got real, he ran out the back door like a coward — away from the same people he was claiming to support just hours earlier.
What’s even more ridiculous? Since that day, Hawley has desperately tried to convince all of us that he’s the authority on what it means to be a man in this country. He even published a whole book about it earlier this year:
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/42478?refcode=em20240110-4580&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=4580%2E614464%2EjU0JZg)
Well... when I think about manhood, I think about courage. And that’s not something you can write a book about.
Missouri is the Show Me State. Courage is something you have to show us.
**That’s why I’m supporting Lucas Kunce for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.** As a born-and-raised Missourian who joined the Marines to serve the community that took care of him growing up, Lucas has already shown us that he knows the true meaning of courage.
Lucas knows courage is about standing up to the powerful and working to rebuild our state. And he knows real leaders fight to empower everyday people and secure our future for generations to come — not for their own power or profit.
**So Peter, if you want to be told about manhood, some guy wrote a book about it.[But if you want someone to show you real courage, please join me in supporting Lucas Kunce for U.S. Senate by adding a donation of $10 to his campaign today.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/42478?refcode=em20240110-4580&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=4580%2E614464%2EjU0JZg)**

Jon Hamm

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: “We never tell the parents anything”
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

_“We never tell the parents anything. She’s an adult in our clinics.”_

_“Trust me, this is not our first rodeo.”_

Those are the words of a Planned Parenthood Managing Director in Kansas City, Missouri who was caught by _Project Veritas_ in a recent undercover video helping a 13-year-old obtain an abortion across state lines.

Meanwhile, a recent U.S. Government Accountability (GAO) study revealed Planned Parenthood received nearly $2 BILLION in federal taxpayer funding between 2019-2021, which includes $90 million that the organization illegally siphoned via the Paycheck Protection Program.

Not only that, but Planned Parenthood bragged about spending $50 MILLION to elect pro-abortion politicians during the 2022 Midterms.

I can only imagine how much more they’re preparing to spend in 2024.

Pro-Life Friend, if you agree Planned Parenthood should be DEFUNDED of 100% of our taxpayer dollars, **[please click here to sign your _"GO FUND YOURSELF PLANNED PARENTHOOD!"_ Petition right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sdlvkd-duchtdja-y/).**

The bottom line is, more taxpayer funding for Planned Parenthood means more abortions.

The _Project Veritas_ video I mentioned at the beginning of this message is the most recent in a long line of, frankly, sickening undercover videos released exposing just how evil the monsters at Planned Parenthood are.

**“It’s a boy!” one of the Planned Parenthood “techs” joked as she sifted through the remains of an aborted baby in one video.**

**Another video showed a Planned Parenthood executive bragging, “I want a Lamborghini” when haggling over the prices of organs she harvests from aborted babies.**

Lamborghini is the maker of exotic Italian sports cars. The cheapest sells for over $200,000! Some models sell for _millions_.

The Planned Parenthood workers apparently think the more than 1,025 innocent preborn lives they snuff out every day are nothing more than a “joke” that also happens to line their pockets with millions.

Pro-Life Friend, this is as evil as it gets.

The good news is, after the _Dobbs v. Jackson_ decision, we’ve witnessed several abortion facilities in states with strong life-protecting laws shut their doors for good.

But, as the undercover _Project Veritas_ video shows, Planned Parenthoods are ushering vulnerable young women across state lines every day to commit abortions.

And the kicker is, you and I are footing the bill!

According to its own annual report, Planned Parenthood receives more than 35% of its annual revenue from U.S. taxpayers.

Any business owner knows if 35% of their revenue is wiped out overnight, they would be toast.

So, if you and I are able to cut off taxpayer funding from Planned Parenthood, the Abortion Goliath would be forced to shut down even more abortion facilities for good!

**[Pro-Life Friend, if you’re fed up with the inaction from our elected officials, please click here to sign your _"GO FUND YOURSELF PLANNED PARENTHOOD!"_ Petition](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sdlvkd-duchtdja-j/).**

After you sign your name, please forward this message to all of your pro-life family and friends and ask them to sign the petition as well.

And if you can, **[please chip in $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can afford to help _Students for Life Action_ ramp up the pressure on Congress ahead of November](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sdlvkd-duchtdja-i/).**

2024 is the year to hold the self-proclaimed “pro-life” politicians’ feet to the fire.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. - Planned Parenthood was caught in an undercover video investigation by _Project Veritas_ helping a 13-year-old girl get an abortion across state lines while hiding the whole ordeal from her parents.

This is just the most recent in a long line of undercover videos released over the past few years showing how utterly evil the Abortion Goliath is.

Meanwhile, a recent U.S. Government Accountability (GAO) study revealed Planned Parenthood received nearly $2 BILLION in federal taxpayer funding between 2019-2021, which includes $90 million that the organization illegally siphoned via the Paycheck Protection Program!

P.P.S. – If you agree Planned Parenthood should be DEFUNDED of 100% of our taxpayer dollars, **[please click here to sign your _"GO FUND YOURSELF PLANNED PARENTHOOD!"_ Petition right away](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sdlvkd-duchtdja-d/).**

After you sign your name, **[please forward this petition to your pro-life family and friends and chip in $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can afford to help _Students for Life Action_ ramp up pressure on Congress in 2024 to finally DEFUND Planned Parenthood](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sdlvkd-duchtdja-h/)!**

Chairman Jim Walsh provides a response to Jay Inslee claiming that the state of our state has never been stronger.

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

body:
In this eleven-lecture course, Dr. Kevin Slack, associate professor of politics at Hillsdale College, examines the transformation in American politics since World War II.

| | | This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38983%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=IhsxzG4IRzGtnrbpbCrvOA&sysid=1)
---
| | Dear Friend,

I am excited to announce that Hillsdale’s online course, [“The American Left: From Liberalism to Despotism,”](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38984%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=kVCPSSBuVxYPHtcI3NFl1g&sysid=1) is now available to own on DVD.

In this eleven-lecture course, Dr. Kevin Slack, associate professor of politics at Hillsdale College, examines the transformation in American politics since World War II.

He explains the origins of 1960s radicalism and its rejection of midcentury liberalism; he reveals how these radicals came to dominate government and the universities beginning in the late 1970s; and he explores the rise of a neoliberal oligarchy in America and that oligarchy’s alliance with the cultural Left in President Obama’s second term.

This course seeks to understand the key people, ideas, and aims of the modern Left and to provide solutions for defending the American way of life today.

Will you partner with us to promote this free online course and expand other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty? As a token of our appreciation for your support, we’ll send you the DVD Box Set of the course for a gift of $100 or more.

# We Must End Wasteful Government Spending
By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District
---
Each year, the Federal Government wastes billions of your tax dollars. This is money you paid and got nothing in return. We need to get rid of big spenders in Washington. Congress must take back its Constitutional duty of controlling the national purse.
Near the end of each year, Senator Rand Paul publishes a list of wasteful spending. His 2023 list contained $482 billion in waste, including:

* $118,000 to study whether Marvel movie villain Thanos would be able to snap his fingers while wearing the Infinity Gauntlet
* $2.7 million to study Russian cats walking on a treadmill
* $6 million for boosting Egyptian tourism
* $33 million for a research island of 3,000 monkeys
* $200 million given to "struggling" musicians
* $100+ billion of COVID relief funds given to ineligible people

This is a drop in the bucket compared to the $4 trillion the government added to the national debt in 2023. Interest on the debt doubled to $659 billion.
Forty percent of American households pay no federal income tax. For the 60% of American households who do pay taxes, the most common amount is about $5,000 per year. This means it took 24 American households paying $5,000 to study the Marvel Movie, 540 households to study Russian cats, 1,200 households to boost Egyptian tourism, 6,600 households to pay for an island of monkeys, 40,000 households to pay for "struggling" musicians, and more than 200,000 households to pay for inept government agencies who sent COVID money to ineligible people.
In total, it took the taxes paid by more than 20,000,000 American households to pay for just one year of interest and wasteful government spending.
Think about that! Your hard-earned money wasted by thoughtless bureaucrats. How does that make you feel? I hope you're fed up and ready to do something! We have got to get rid of these big spenders in Congress (from both parties).
Take a close look at the candidates running for Congress. Make sure you don't support any big spenders. Last year, I was outspent in the primary but won by nearly a two-to-one margin. I "walk the talk." I live within a budget in my personal life and in my campaign.
Here's how we fix the problem: As your representative, I will fight to return regular order to the budgeting process. I will do all I can to strip government agencies of their power to waste government funds and return the power of the purse to the people's representatives. Together, we can take back our country!
*******
---
Your Questions--Mark's Answers
Mark Robertson answers your questions with direct and honest answers. Here are two questions Mark was asked recently:
Q: Do you support the United States' efforts in sending money to Ukraine in their war efforts against Russia? -B.C. A. The United States should support the people of Ukraine in their fight for freedom. The amount of support we are providing is a small fraction of our defense budget. This is a bargain for the United States. By providing equipment, ammunition, and supplies to Ukraine, we are severely degrading the military capability of Russia (one of our top threats) without having to send our troops. That being said, we should carefully monitor the use of the aid we are sending to make sure it is not being used to enrich corrupt politicians. I served in Afghanistan and witnessed firsthand the waste, fraud, and abuse of the funds we sent there.
Q. In the event of another COVID outbreak, will you support efforts similar to what was in place before with the shutdowns, mask mandates, and pressure to accept vaccinations? -R.J. A. No. As I said during the COVID pandemic, the Government should give clear, accurate, and honest information and allow Americans to make their own decisions on what precautions they should take. Well-informed people can then make their own decisions on what is best for them and their families. The government should have never shut down our schools and the economy. Americans should have the freedom to decide these issues for themselves.
Please share this message with friends and neighbors. Have questions for me? Simply reply to this email to ask me a question.

## Hunter Biden Visit Upends Contempt Hearing
Two House committees recommended that [Hunter Biden be held in contempt,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOqzAQAL_GdEa7GycmhYvX0OW1VyJjlrAnYyNjwt3fn3L11SPNSPPxGB5eoqTnf7-yq3MefKjy4gE1oiYzmGZyMzPxpWGHFsy9I0TbLA5pvPNsgmG2DH5mvly9n2_WAHahg0YcARlARITrFbANE4C9ddaMIRBbUAZ4kppL-5kl1YXn-J1fXNqQ1ya6pdZtV5d_inpF_Xmerf-SvL-pov7tVtQDKuoRFPXLkSoXPcrESYecKq9b1Qv7Iumpl3zsrAtvxxgl-LQ3xU3bKTHKfrPKwHP1En_L9c8PPwEAAP__rKJepw) but only after he surprised Congress by personally showing up for the vote, throwing the hearing into chaos. Rep. Nancy Mace, seeing Biden in the audience, called him the "epitome of white privilege." [On video, Mace asked](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DHvpCAUBPBPg90zgLi4hcU2VrfXXmkQnvIuCBtAzX77i1f_qyl-U0zmz3t-GwoUt99mx7GuaTa20omzACFAqlk1blwRJXYNjkJz9RykELrxo3Rd3yuxPp3slwEHzfvFPoelGwa9ouUNjZJLxYUQgvc9F611nOvHoNVirUTNmeLoqKbc_k0Uq8c1fNOJubVpb8Loa_0U1r2YnJicrutq9xJvY3LCCEdhcop43ZGqx3yXTLUeoon2C7uxCMVndAX8EStmWMhhhDVl8OakuEFMsJgQCpj19nLkT6aCcFKhCg6zoVDAp6MgeDSZ4sbkZDK8XmL_tT14k0f3uSgEKg_NFN92Q-H__vrjm_8CAAD__8LIeJk) what he was afraid of and then said, "You have no balls." In the hallway afterward, Biden was besieged by reporters. [One video shows](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz79OwzAQgPGnsbdWdxf_aQYPMGQrK2Pk2OfG4CRVcrTi7ZFgZf6GT7_363iNtdX19hYXDlK2MSapDx7xhHgiMxqdQ2Em7jQH9GD6CyF6PQcsecodONdPLnpOfYk5-8tkJ5tNYdQ1EJABRESwFvCcMoB3F2-mlIg9KAOcq2z7-WOrq8xc2vf24P2ctkW3MIvcD9W9KBoUDfKsIn9N0fC6c_ys661HVDQcEuXrUDSgNxbJEnSIzlLnLeo95PuztlYP55WB2xJr-z3Iv96fAAAA__8S-VP4) someone calling out the question: "What kind of crack do you normally smoke, Mr. Biden?" The committee reports recommending contempt will move now to the full House for a vote. If it passes, it would be referred to the Justice Department for potential prosecution.
## U.S. Ships Hit With Large Attack
U.S. and British naval forces battled[ the largest attack to date](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtu6zAQBb-G6lYg19SrUHEbdb5tSoEm1-ImFGmIawv5-8Cp05zmAIPBfFzXq-PEefvvdprlXlbnhV-0GjAG0K62CfOdCOnS0GwGbacRjRmaOE-hm9B3_RSc7agfOxcIJ_Ld1OOgx7HhGTVabYwxuuu0aX3QeujHwd68Rxq0spoCSznaz8JZIt3Td3nR0fqyN2mOIo-qLv8ULgqX8zxbn2_-fSpc3miFizbvmRQusTwlMuycWNhVSO6ZfYQbbxtVASfi_BdIgeCEoGTY6fDRZYEX1UqpAmc4KEAl10bZU3PM4XFySlz7QVm97Y7Tr5r8GeonAAD__-eFaZw) on merchant shipping by Iranian-backed Houthi rebels, shooting down 21 drones and missiles aimed at 50 freighters in the area. No casualties were reported. British leaders called the situation "unsustainable" and hinted that the U.S.-led coalition would [take aggressive action](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuwyAQQL8GNlt3Z2KSgaGLt3TtaAF3xFTYRDaK1b-v0rnre9KT3td9vvtc8vb49Ku4lursY8svmbFD7MjMRrNLIiSDFocWzO1KiFYvzqaAJsp4C5KiZ8_BDmDYhJDAM6POjoAMICLC5QLYRwaw49WaECOJBWVAOLe69981b22RVH7qS_Y-1lUXt7T2PNTwoWhSNJ3n2YcQ307RtMl5vGHdC3drZi7SiT9aN9rbQJYuenf8PHMp-RitMvBYfS5_4fbv5m8AAAD__-YuU3s), including strikes in Yemen. "_Watch this space_ ," said UK Defense Secretary Grant Shapps. The Pentagon said four coalition warships were deployed to the area. They reported assaults from rocket fire and armed drones. It was the first large-scale attack since the U.S. built a coalition to protect shipping in the Red Sea.
## Alabama Coach Nick Saban to Retire

| | Dear Friend,

I am excited to announce that Hillsdale's online course, ["The American Left: From Liberalism to Despotism,"](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=000192c87955410f8eaf08e1813e7629&_e=wGlJQn0hVTVMCz9mnflwXecp0Wur-AalB1PWgLovsi82O2HplYNp1JDR36b3UjZ_O-EViZYS7dm96Zh9HysYpS1NFVMRiHuA39ijSRWxtS42yrrwbAbKmpBaP4LeaRxvrmKvYyksNjnd3SZwn71sRRPIF2FLQVBKRrwzU27y-usPykQ0jsnMLOF9FRNTkNjM5sXsg8y_jmMqtAlK2V5nkDuRJ-8ZQDeW5a-JLLuMSVddmGY3Sl9DUpHzIsgcTmcmra0DqANzUszFwR1xm_e4dB2hK-7T0FlvvvaCPqqSXS_q7FvopEfbBCOqJp7-Nipx7PQjbeZBy7Uv_8UxxVlf4r4jYNEvgpawp-DFjmDs-TfOqc9eqfRRW95kZIjBQETvyZepGZSt_FxHW4oWa_Gse_GcU_6kI13BItm09fKcb9A%3D) is now available to own on DVD.

In this eleven-lecture course, Dr. Kevin Slack, associate professor of politics at Hillsdale College, examines the transformation in American politics since World War II.

He explains the origins of 1960s radicalism and its rejection of midcentury liberalism; he reveals how these radicals came to dominate government and the universities beginning in the late 1970s; and he explores the rise of a neoliberal oligarchy in America and that oligarchy's alliance with the cultural Left in President Obama's second term.

This course seeks to understand the key people, ideas, and aims of the modern Left and to provide solutions for defending the American way of life today.

Will you partner with us to promote this free online course and expand other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty? As a token of our appreciation for your support, we'll send you the DVD Box Set of the course for a gift of $100 or more.

I have nearly 20 years of experience practicing law including time spent in private practice, the Utah Attorney General's office, and providing legal advice to the State Board of Education and Utah League of Cities and Towns. subject: MEDIA RELEASE: Repeal Measure 110
body:
[](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xthije-dihkkhuuli-r/) MEDIA RELEASE
January 10, 2024
Contact: info@and-or.org _**Repeal Measure 110: Christine Drazan Publishes Op-Ed Urging Lawmakers to Fully Repeal the Measure**_ **CANBY, Ore.** - Today, _The Oregonian_ published an op-ed from Christine Drazan urging lawmakers to repeal Measure 110 fully.
"Oregon is facing a five-alarm fire of drug abuse, addiction and death. Instead of dousing the flames, politicians continue to pour gasoline on the fire by refusing to confront this crisis head-on. Every day our elected officials waste on inaction and political excuses, more people will die," Drazan writes.The column highlights five recommendations based on conversations with behavioral health experts, service providers, law enforcement officers, housing providers, legislators, and community leaders from both sides of the aisle: **Drug use should be discouraged, addiction services must prioritize sobriety, data must drive investment, kids aren 't adults, and accountability saves lives. ****[Read the full op-ed here.](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-xthije-dihkkhuuli-y/)** "Oregonians know Measure 110 is killing people. Politicians who want to protect Measure 110 at all costs, are costing lives. If the big idea from Salem is to simply limit public use of hard drugs, they will simply kill more people behind closed doors. It is time to end this deadly experiment and repeal Measure 110," Drazan said. ### A New Direction is a 501(c)4 non-profit organization dedicated to connecting Oregonians with each other to advance policies and ideas that make Oregon a safer, more affordable place to live and raise a family, strengthen checks and balances, improve transparency, empower Oregonians and support the next generation. | | Dear Friend,

I am excited to announce that Hillsdale's online course, ["The American Left: From Liberalism to Despotism,"](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=eff214f3af444214ab3a0a044934d49c&_e=eCtQwQB7MDn4soMJQW5bwPO-7F-yXmduaCz0SjbLja4pVBnIqsNF5PqO784HNKbvLUY-VuVXPVQ7OMSAE5twao6MEpBvPAVlC7ZfBQ0bUYyGhsYEzPXpcF9jc7Hujlt-7eOWtiKjkpMd41x1VpSHrLEGL-gsZYyvEaIHp4WxsC_rVTZbVskpevXS1nDYt2rEHePeZJa7iz2ABvUesrGBXL06Mz6oUJh3vuP0B_tkg48UObsuKCTvjcnFS6JQLCBAEe7Oj4FoC3T8eAeCgdt_FJw_nnNN0Quli_8pBsoJJSNwTv5ogtgYOfctbWVYy5X-4fzLDSNznE4hsB71PqMeah0FD9UYaKdwXE8BD48jJfRNoaCTc_CikkM1GnjvET6vBimVU1CQsUgEyS66q8IiEJLmPxsOVuYSJDaMtApubNw%3D) is now available to own on DVD.

In this eleven-lecture course, Dr. Kevin Slack, associate professor of politics at Hillsdale College, examines the transformation in American politics since World War II.

He explains the origins of 1960s radicalism and its rejection of midcentury liberalism; he reveals how these radicals came to dominate government and the universities beginning in the late 1970s; and he explores the rise of a neoliberal oligarchy in America and that oligarchy's alliance with the cultural Left in President Obama's second term.

This course seeks to understand the key people, ideas, and aims of the modern Left and to provide solutions for defending the American way of life today.

Will you partner with us to promote this free online course and expand other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty? As a token of our appreciation for your support, we'll send you the DVD Box Set of the course for a gift of $100 or more.

I am excited to announce that Hillsdale's online course, ["The American Left: From Liberalism to Despotism,"](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2c875175b82344ca8f5458703e048af3&_e=FjIvkvRYmOBUfDkYWmV5bot4_Ws7NpKnBtAF4jcbMjIUv9u28Wt4K2dHaP94RbzzN2bX1QeHgFOK1EbPFIL1IuyoThce4NiIH653OJ-6zUjlBzZCMQoMM7PfSyZqszRO4PzNM5g36qNYhjN1ZdxSp-aI10JlGDqJDLiUL0DdJ0TiD_OR2NJH6NKxEWr9BsUCQDK0Z5CY78h72SULHzBP-NxixmFSPFK9M3Yu__DGnA0kFdm8bKevdx4LgZBPv2BNAN0BmozSOx3YOh9oPpN9Dq2sfmGZS2QVXzkFVBYEoekFWHu6eLPPxqrgX_NrqnWz7czZq39L1DlqpO2C5PCeeFO7cQtSf0TxH_jqVqnmk9rtiJRlrgGdi_63W9aPIMGDTqkCF4E82L0-JiYe7OREAy9v9FUACi5BbnUt6WX3shw%3D) is now available to own on DVD.

In this eleven-lecture course, Dr. Kevin Slack, associate professor of politics at Hillsdale College, examines the transformation in American politics since World War II.

He explains the origins of 1960s radicalism and its rejection of midcentury liberalism; he reveals how these radicals came to dominate government and the universities beginning in the late 1970s; and he explores the rise of a neoliberal oligarchy in America and that oligarchy's alliance with the cultural Left in President Obama's second term.

This course seeks to understand the key people, ideas, and aims of the modern Left and to provide solutions for defending the American way of life today.

Will you partner with us to promote this free online course and expand other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty? As a token of our appreciation for your support, we'll send you the DVD Box Set of the course for a gift of $100 or more.

Breaking news, Friend!

Wednesday night's debate was so incredible, we want YOU 🫵 to
be in the audience at the next one in New Hampshire... Sound good
to you? Be the FIRST to enter the contest!

ENTER TO WIN A TRIP TO THE NEXT DEBATE WITH
RON DESANTIS

On
January 20th, one final debate before the New Hampshire primary
will be aired by CNN and Ron DeSantis is ready to meet you there.
ENTER NOW and donate $5 or more as many times as you can so you
can see all the action in person. There is no telling what's
going to happen on that stage just days ahead of the
first-in-the-nation primary.

If
you win, we're going to cover the cost of your flight, tickets to
the debate, hotel, and make sure you get to meet Ron DeSantis
stress-free.

See
you in New Hampshire?

-
Team DeSantis

Get to Know Ron DeSantis

Ron DeSantis comes from
blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to
him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the
Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate
degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was
so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered
to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a
life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and
now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting
to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in
this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every
turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and
consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his
life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and
3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that
this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents
face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political
agenda down the throats of children.

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has
promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected
bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to
children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by
immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our
southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the
mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring
our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on
track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record
speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment,
politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the
legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his
leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has
stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next
President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill
for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for
President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the
decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for
another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act
is now.

name: Speaker Mike Johnson
subject: Personal Letter for You
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mike Johnson for Louisiana
body:
This message is an opportunity to introduce myself.

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zuq83rcf063ru766k9mmtptq3kqt1ucacr49cc80_rp22sh2s8i6eo31cjie6o32c9h2bs)
---
**_“Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson.”_** When I heard that aloud for the first time it was truly a surreal experience. Even now, as I write it down I’m both humbled and thrilled. I am honored beyond imagination and completely understand how great of a responsibility it is to lead the House of Representatives on behalf of patriotic Americans like you. This message is an opportunity to introduce myself, and I’m truly grateful that you’re reading this right now – but before I tell you my story, I have a request: **_Firstly, would you pray for me?_** I’ve always believed in the power of prayer. That’s why I’m asking that you pray on my behalf that God would guide my hand and my gavel through my tenure as Speaker of the House. **_Secondly,[would you join Team Johnson?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z2phehngkeksoehinfsv1c0pa431nkn36qsts770_rp22sh2s8i6eo31cjie6o32c9h2bs) [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zqabr6phvg09v3vlql12b8mvv3fjdo44gu5mi5p0_rp22sh2s8i6eo31cjie6o32c9h2bs)_**The House Republican Majority will soon be down to just a razor-thin margin and America is at a true crossroads. Will we submit and allow Democrats to take back the House in 2024, or will we fight back and expand our majority? **[To stand strong and fight back, we truly need your support.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zdjbvhqkhmhgdpn0jmis4bc9f611p8nu8hhmitn0_rp22sh2s8i6eo31cjie6o32c9h2bs)** **[Even $1 could be the difference between Republican and Democrat Control.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zf9ge3e6e1c8jvbqvk70fvdstbqabbvokv9hjhb0_rp22sh2s8i6eo31cjie6o32c9h2bs)** Growing up, my dad was a fireman. To me, he was Superman, and I wanted to be just like him. For the longest time I was set on serving my community as a firefighter — but after my father was severely injured while on the job, he discouraged me from following in his footsteps. So I turned to my other passion of service: The Law. I was the first member of my family to earn a Bachelor’s degree. And just a few years later, I graduated from law school. I would go on to specialize in Constitutional Law and dedicate my career to defending religious liberty. I also founded a non-profit law firm to defend Christians against religious persecution. In 2016 I ran to become a member of the House of Representatives and WON. Since then, I’ve spent every day working to defend freedom for generations to come. I’ve spent the last 20 years on the front lines of the fight to defend our constitution, our country, and our faith. As long as there is breath in my lungs, I won’t stop fighting. Friend, I know you might have heard of me for the first time ever on the news just a few months ago. That’s why I wanted you to hear my story from me, directly, with no media talking heads between us. **[Now that you know a little more about me and what I stand for, I hope that you’ll join Team Johnson.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zg22end8p2uj6u7euhhghqri5c8cmnbiavtkd5l8_rp22sh2s8i6eo31cjie6o32c9h2bs)**
---
[**JOIN TEAM JOHNSON TODAY**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zdb6r52has7vtmts77to7r9f1rmdep7uio66ilv8_rp22sh2s8i6eo31cjie6o32c9h2bs)
---
Thank you so much for your time and support, Friend. Sincerely,
---
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zo54f6lj59d71hunj6eftbl56l5u0stgmjlgdkr8_rp22sh2s8i6eo31cjie6o32c9h2bs)
---
Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson P.S. I love this country and I’m deeply grateful for the opportunity to serve. But Team Johnson can’t save America from the radical left and turn things around without the help of patriots like you. That’s why I hope and pray that we can count on your support. **[Would you consider joining Team Johnson today?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zivgrps5oucns2sa022iogpkqcim5lpsbmo5t33g_rp22sh2s8i6eo31cjie6o32c9h2bs)**

We don't have time to waste. We have to get this election right, NOW.

| |

| | | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c680975%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=EcCIqU8oQx1EPnCHaNkAtA&sysid=1)
---

Friend,

After last night’s debate it’s clear: **This is now a two person race between me and Donald Trump. **

Every American needs to know it’s never been more urgent than it is now to get things right in this election.

Winning the primary is the first step in this race.

But we have to be looking at the bigger picture here. This is about electing a candidate who can **DEFEAT** Joe Biden.

If you look at the polls, I defeat Joe Biden by 17 points. That’s a mandate to fix our out-of-control spending, to get our kids reading, to secure our border with no excuses, to bring law and order back to this country.

_**[Will you join me so we can WIN this fight to save our future?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c680976%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4GjK00ldD%2fgTffkACzOq4Q&sysid=1 "Will you join me so we can
WIN this fight to save our future?")**_

---

---

**The truth is:** Republicans have lost the popular vote in 7 out of the last 8 presidential elections.

_**I’m tired of losing and you should be, too.**_ It's time for a new generation to step up, lead us into the future, and save the country we all love from the downward spiral of socialism and defeatism.

But we are in a critical stretch of this election with the first votes taking place in just 4 days.

We don't have time to waste. We have to get this election right, _**NOW. **_

**[If you’re tired of losing, then put your trust in a new generation. And, if you want to win- not just for our party, _but for our country_ - then put your trust in me.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c680978%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=OSN41biIPHFJcSOSeXCS1Q&sysid=1 "If you’re tired of losing,

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c680974%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4ONwSojBgY0jvS1lBDozAA&sysid=1 "Will you join me today and

subject: Personal Letter for You
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mike Johnson for Louisiana
body:
This message is an opportunity to introduce myself.

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ziqf7593q20rm6qoaeje5kpvelgju6g787c29a4g_rp22sh2s8i6eo31cjie9pr0cph2bs)
---
**_“Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson.”_** When I heard that aloud for the first time it was truly a surreal experience. Even now, as I write it down I’m both humbled and thrilled. I am honored beyond imagination and completely understand how great of a responsibility it is to lead the House of Representatives on behalf of patriotic Americans like you. This message is an opportunity to introduce myself, and I’m truly grateful that you’re reading this right now – but before I tell you my story, I have a request: **_Firstly, would you pray for me?_** I’ve always believed in the power of prayer. That’s why I’m asking that you pray on my behalf that God would guide my hand and my gavel through my tenure as Speaker of the House. **_Secondly,[would you join Team Johnson?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zts1tqbg11mu21gbdbvcdu50n9aaud3l8khroii0_rp22sh2s8i6eo31cjie9pr0cph2bs) [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7gotp3sifsf99mu16mlvkpt0dicsa8jv7jhrc8g_rp22sh2s8i6eo31cjie9pr0cph2bs)_**The House Republican Majority will soon be down to just a razor-thin margin and America is at a true crossroads. Will we submit and allow Democrats to take back the House in 2024, or will we fight back and expand our majority? **[To stand strong and fight back, we truly need your support.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zknraq8uitsbth2a3fdhfat2fed75at91o7g3s98_rp22sh2s8i6eo31cjie9pr0cph2bs)** **[Even $1 could be the difference between Republican and Democrat Control.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkt7cfiv4k8lvottgmpaakerq79eng5oog6hltcg_rp22sh2s8i6eo31cjie9pr0cph2bs)** Growing up, my dad was a fireman. To me, he was Superman, and I wanted to be just like him. For the longest time I was set on serving my community as a firefighter — but after my father was severely injured while on the job, he discouraged me from following in his footsteps. So I turned to my other passion of service: The Law. I was the first member of my family to earn a Bachelor’s degree. And just a few years later, I graduated from law school. I would go on to specialize in Constitutional Law and dedicate my career to defending religious liberty. I also founded a non-profit law firm to defend Christians against religious persecution. In 2016 I ran to become a member of the House of Representatives and WON. Since then, I’ve spent every day working to defend freedom for generations to come. I’ve spent the last 20 years on the front lines of the fight to defend our constitution, our country, and our faith. As long as there is breath in my lungs, I won’t stop fighting. Friend, I know you might have heard of me for the first time ever on the news just a few months ago. That’s why I wanted you to hear my story from me, directly, with no media talking heads between us. **[Now that you know a little more about me and what I stand for, I hope that you’ll join Team Johnson.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zbom9re6415vi1bk3um54nbs8lk981imk13004l0_rp22sh2s8i6eo31cjie9pr0cph2bs)**
---
[**JOIN TEAM JOHNSON TODAY**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zicvd88u49ss1g9uctaq5d28ddr4cgtfma8efdjo_rp22sh2s8i6eo31cjie9pr0cph2bs)
---
Thank you so much for your time and support, Friend. Sincerely,
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjahmvprqpe1d8vamtf7oblq62qrh3n0dnb2adf8_rp22sh2s8i6eo31cjie9pr0cph2bs)
---
Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson P.S. I love this country and I’m deeply grateful for the opportunity to serve. But Team Johnson can’t save America from the radical left and turn things around without the help of patriots like you. That’s why I hope and pray that we can count on your support. **[Would you consider joining Team Johnson today?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zlvkmkj3g8o0o15it520ko1g0hd3i60onuup973o_rp22sh2s8i6eo31cjie9pr0cph2bs)**

| | As we enter 2024, we’re up against a right-wing machine that has poured millions of dollars into restricting voter access, attacking election administration, and subverting the will of voters. And before you can defeat someone, you have to understand them. You have to know what they’re aiming to achieve and how they operate. That’s why we’ve analyzed the anti-voter extremists we face — so we can get the better of them. _Here’s what Fair Fight has identified as the three core prongs of the anti-voter playbook, according to our latest monitoring:_
1. **Pushing access to the ballot as far out of reach as possible** through mass voter challenges and aggressive voter purges, reduced polling locations and hours, limiting mail ballot and dropbox access, and other restrictions that disproportionately burden voters of color.
2. **Attacking election administration from every angle.** This includes burdening election workers and Boards of Elections (BOEs) with an endless barrage of unfunded mandates passed by anti-voter state legislators, pushing anti-voter conspiracy theorists onto BOEs, and emerging attempts to privatize so-called “list maintenance” through new and unreliable software like EagleAI.

body:
My opponent’s consistent support for abusers and enablers is disturbing and sickening.
| | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001EtjRzmxEVGfGGc_bfmAPn8krrNUv2YhmhogQrbjuGGoEGaV3T5BmF1bjUBOI6vhZKrqOViUd6Q9ylM4XvDUPypsA2OlPaj3bjPpVqxRHBw--UJx2LjEWuWt6FnP5EbDWhTc2jOZT_9BkR4ogLzDAbVEAFbzFRwrky7bbMAMe8s9-hNplfzKyGQ-VTHOHqYejrKRCEt0G7wBlYac66o6n0A==&c=Tj_eyWHCLGwU3tSMQSbL71WE82TU7B_vbXgBEkmoEUHfHmcMqGRxYg==&ch=QvrgRNnL3oiL3aO-qOtJwoUuE4ZNjj1c-EK4nEMrHwOVd4v5XB6EIg==)
---

Friend,
I'm reaching out with an urgent concern that goes beyond politics - the basic integrity of our leaders. My opponent Troy Balderson's unwavering support for Jim Jordan, in spite of the distressing allegations from his time as a wrestling coach at Ohio State University, is deeply troubling.
This is isn't just some kind of rumor or so-called cancel culture vendetta. Dozens of former OSU wrestlers have courageously spoken up, accusing Jordan of ignoring years of sexual abuse by Richard Strauss, a team doctor who died in 2005:
---
[](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001EtjRzmxEVGfGGc_bfmAPn8krrNUv2YhmhogQrbjuGGoEGaV3T5BmF1bjUBOI6vhZi6PcbnHd5OMKXh73HqC4i2Slqkby4Tv1UGjOh6swTkF-xCc3191d5R6jS4Bg5SbDym8AXkNAgw9VdZwuymqWg3euh6e4TUVQjjoA9_O1awrGiyB8_TXBQYP8Z7G7LHaIejjahGy0fK-_pLsxfLwKNQ==&c=Tj_eyWHCLGwU3tSMQSbL71WE82TU7B_vbXgBEkmoEUHfHmcMqGRxYg==&ch=QvrgRNnL3oiL3aO-qOtJwoUuE4ZNjj1c-EK4nEMrHwOVd4v5XB6EIg==)
---
Jordan has consistently refused to cooperate with an official investigation which found Strauss's abuse "was an open secret." The report also stated that "coaches, trainers and other team physicians were fully aware of Strauss' activities, and yet few seemed inclined to do anything to stop it."
Pretty on brand for today's MAGA Republican Party.
At a hearing of the Ohio state legislature, former wrestler Adam DiSabato, said "Jim Jordan called me crying, crying, groveling, on the Fourth of July...begging me to go against my brother, begging me, crying for half an hour. That's the kind of cover-up that's going on here. He's a coward."
A former wrestler named Dunyasha Yetts previously said: "If Jordan says he didn't know about it, then he's lying."
Speaking to NBC, another former wrestler, Rocky Ratliff, said Jordan "abandoned his former wrestlers in the Ohio State sexual abuse scandal and cover-up."

Dear Friend
It's almost petition season here in PA. Team Daniels is getting ready to secure Shamaine's place on the Democratic ballot in April, and we're asking for your help.
In case you aren't familiar, candidates for office in Pennsylvania need to gather signatures on nominating petitions in order to get their name on the ballot. Congressional candidates need to collect a minimum of 1,000 signatures from registered voters of their party in their district.
Here at Team Daniels, our goal is to collect at least 1,500 to 2,000 signatures of registered Democrats in PA-10. This is no small task because these signatures must be gathered in-person. We will be relying on volunteers across the district to knock on doors and host petition signing events to help us reach our goal. That means we need clipboards, pens (that work in cold temperatures), water, hot coffee and snacks for volunteers, and lots of cookies and other treats for supporters who are opening their homes to host a petition signing event.
This is where you come in! Can you pitch-in $10, $25, $50, $100 or more to help us support our petition gathering efforts? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1016%2E135344%2EdMK4ub)

Hey there,
2024 is off to an exciting start: We just got the [**first general election public poll**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/2012?t=2&akid=1016%2E135344%2EdMK4ub) in our race since early fall — and A LOT has changed since then. I wanted to share a bit more about what we learned from this new poll and — importantly — how we use information like this to inform our campaign strategy, especially now that we’re fully in the election year.
But first, the toplines of the poll:
**Elissa Slotkin: 37.5%
Republican Mike Rogers: 37.5%

Elissa Slotkin: 36.3%
Republican Peter Meijer: 35.7%

Elissa Slotkin: 35.5%
Republican James Craig: 37.8% **
In other words, we’re currently statistically tied with 3 of the top Republicans in the race. And that’s no surprise: Anyone who knows Michigan well could tell you that this race was going to be incredibly close. On top of that, the presidential race here in Michigan remains very competitive – meaning we’ll have not only one, but two close races to win here in November.
But I’m a bit of a data nerd, so I like to go beyond the toplines. And while a poll this early always has to be taken with a grain of salt, here’s one of the numbers my team and I are watching: name identification, or ID, aka the percentage of the 10 million people across Michigan who have heard of me. Right now, that’s about 45% of Michiganders – not surprising, given that I have only represented my one congressional district the last few years, and we have a big state. And while all of the GOP opponents have less name ID, our number one priority in this campaign is introducing myself to the millions of people who live a ways from my current district. This poll is a reminder that we’ve still got a ways to go, particularly with the many Michiganders who have little interest in government and politics.
**Another key takeaway: No matter which Republican candidate is on the other side, more than a quarter of all voters remain undecided.** Those are the people we need to communicate with -– and who will ultimately decide this election, as well as the Presidential race.
We’ve been doing the work of traveling across Michigan, but now that we’re in the election year, things will ramp up FAST. We’ll be spending the next 10 months visiting as many cities and towns as we can, sending mail, putting up ads on TV, investing in digital ads, and running a robust field operation.
All of those things are represented by line items in our budget. **We’ve mapped out what it will take to win, but we know this race will be one of the most competitive and expensive in the country, which means that we are relying on people like you to chip in and make our plans a reality.**
[**Will you chip in to help me introduce myself to voters across Michigan and win this competitive race in November?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-jan24.--Kpen&refcode=em240111-1-30&t=3&akid=1016%2E135344%2EdMK4ub)

body:

| Friend, This is my first appeal of 2024 and it could prove to be the most consequential. | | | Hi, Peter, National Republicans just confirmed that Mitch McConnell’s handpicked candidate, Eric Hovde, will run against me in Wisconsin’s Senate race — and he’ll have their full support. It’s time to get to work, friend. Ron DeSantis fought for school choice on the debate stage last night by drawing on his proven blueprint in Florida. More here.

Friend, Ron DeSantis is fighting for the rights of parents to decide what's best for their children and for children to receive the education they deserve. Unlike Nikki Haley, he is NOT just talk. He's got the proven record to show he never backs down from fighting for the kids: Parents' rights have been increasingly under assault around the nation, but in Florida, he stood up for the rights of parents and the fundamental role they play in the education of their children:
---
| [](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=5283b1a9b87866a78efad3f8ceff773331c399e1331bd7c1ec763a9c2111f44492c7cdf4b0da4b2518fb6cfc88033107841168b657dbaa1e)
---
* School choice is available for all Floridians.
* Florida is ranked #1 for education freedom and #1 for parental empowerment, and we are #1 in state spending on private school choice and #1 in school choice enrollments.
* Florida eliminated Critical Race Theory in its K-12 schools.
* Florida has established robust civics education requirements so that students learn about the Constitution and what it means to be an American.

Politics is not entertainment. It's not about fanfare. It's about producing results for the people you serve. Ron DeSantis is the ONLY candidate who understands this. He is up on that stage fighting for you and we need your help supporting him now.

---
| | | [ ](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=5283b1a9b87866a78efad3f8ceff773331c399e1331bd7c1ec763a9c2111f44492c7cdf4b0da4b2518fb6cfc88033107841168b657dbaa1e)
---

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

---
| [](https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=5283b1a9b87866a78efad3f8ceff773331c399e1331bd7c1ec763a9c2111f44492c7cdf4b0da4b2518fb6cfc88033107841168b657dbaa1e)
---

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

---

I spent countless hours gathering signatures, distributing signs, and persuading voters to protect abortion rights. Today, Ohio Republicans are attempting to undermine the will of their own voters and stop the implementation of the constitutional provision establishing the right to abortion. We can’t let that happen. We need to crush the far-right at the ballot box. Last year, Ohio showed time and time again that it can put aside its previous partisan lean to stand up for what’s right. And we can keep at it in November 2024 and unseat Max Miller, the far-right Congressman who has consistently voted against a women's right to choose.

name: Josh Lafazan
subject: Announcing my Campaign for the New York State Senate!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lafazan for Senate
body:
I'm proud to announce my candidacy for the State Senate this year! | | Dear Peter,

**I’m proud to announce my candidacy for the New York State Senate – because I believe it is time for a new voice in Albany to advocate for us.**

If we've learned anything from the divisiveness of our politics and the challenges facing us in the world today, it’s that people are ready for pragmatic voices that can get things done at all levels of our government.

[**Please consider being a founding donor of our campaign today!**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76905615/448756896/-747717217?refcode=announcement&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTQ2OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOTBjZmJlNi05YWIwLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KU5dQGr2vADxaOIicWoA80ceVZkDjd-ebm3WW3tFzEA=)

**I am committed to being a voice for the people of Nassau County – and I will work tirelessly to ensure that our concerns and priorities are heard and addressed in Albany.** During my time as a member of the Syosset School Board and over the past 6 years as a Nassau County Legislator, I have seen firsthand the challenges that our families are facing. Between a skyrocketing cost of living, threats to our public safety and rapidly deteriorating infrastructure and civility - **enough is enough.** I’m proud of the work I’ve done to tackle these issues, including lowering taxes for Nassau County residents by $70M, securing funding for our critical infrastructure needs across the community, and consistently voting to increase our support for law enforcement.

As your State Senator, I plan to deliver increased funding to support our schools and invest in our trade schools, lower taxes and fees to address the affordability crisis in our community, advocate to protect our environment and drinking water, and ensure that our community is safe with additional support for our first responders and law enforcement members.

I believe we must _**stop the politics of division once and for all**_ , and elect leaders willing and capable of _**putting people before politics**_.

Our campaign is just beginning, and I look forward to seeing you on the campaign trail. Thank you for your continued support.

With appreciation,
Josh Lafazan

subject: These questions are at the core of what it means to be human
body:
“What is the good? What is the best way for man to live?”

| | | This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zpq7arip9uk9e7hme964cmm0u1m0pukn0s0d73l0_rp22sh2s8i6eo35c1g66o72cth2bs)
Dear Fellow American, _“What is the good? What is the best way for man to live?”_ _“Does God exist? Can we know God?”_ These questions are at the core of what it means to be human - both in our relationship with each other and with God. Our Western heritage, tracing back to the Hebrews and the ancient Greeks, to Jerusalem and Athens, was where these questions were first asked, and answered. [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z6ar4fg9kn49bamjpcgkeu6rijjrms7o2r1iu4q0_rp22sh2s8i6eo35c1g66o72cth2bs)Every Hillsdale College student is required to take a class on the Western heritage in order to graduate. And every academic year, I’m reminded of the joy it is to pursue the answers to such questions with my students. Today, I want to offer you that same experience... that same pursuit... that same joy... ... by sending you [**a limited-edition DVD box set of Hillsdale's popular online course, “Western Heritage - From the Book of Genesis to John Locke,”**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z698b1se5gte9ubcssh4l89237mub0lg3ju499ro_rp22sh2s8i6eo35c1g66o72cth2bs) as a token of our thanks for a generous contribution in support of Hillsdale's efforts to educate America. This is your opportunity to deepen your understanding about the Golden Age of Greece, Early Christianity, the Renaissance, and the Scientific Revolution. It's your chance to plumb the depths of what makes Western civilization what it is today. And since we recently re-filmed and expanded this course - first offered in 2012 - to feature new lectures and professors, now is the perfect time to add it to your personal library, or give it as a gift. I invite you to study the history of the "big questions" with my colleagues and me. Reserve your DVD set now using this secure link, while they last: [**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/support-western-heritage-dvd**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zhf0p3uigmjpc1fbijp4n79f531g5lf8h09j0l58_rp22sh2s8i6eo35c1g66o72cth2bs) Warm regards, Larry P. | | Peter, I owe my life to this country.
My family escaped Vietnam when I was four years old as it was falling to the Communists, and even though America was unfamiliar at first, in no time, it became the only true home I’ve never known.
As I grew up, I learned that we owed our life to the freedoms in this country. That’s why I decided to dedicate my life to serving it.
**My family and I might not be alive if it wasn’t for the greatest nation on Earth, and I had to repay America the best way I could. I attended the U.S. Naval Academy and went on to serve for 25 years as a Navy Captain in some of the most dangerous corners of the Earth.**
When I was in the Navy, I saw the very best of humanity that America has to offer. _And when I compare it to the “leadership” we see in Washington today, I can’t help but feel we’re missing something._
**It’s no coincidence that as people are losing trust in our elected officials, veteran representation in Congress is at an all-time low.**
_I’m on a mission to change that._
_**My name is Hung Cao, and I’m running for the U.S. Senate because America needs veterans in Washington more than ever.**_

| I’m all-in, and I’m prepared to work even harder these next 54 days before Election Day to share our message. But I can’t do it alone.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=5004%2E5257348%2EpPRd1n)
Derek,
One of the most important things a representative can do is to show up and listen. That is a guiding principle I have carried throughout my time in office.
**[That’s what I intend to do as your U.S. Senator — but first, I need to advance through California’s March 5 U.S. Senate primary. Can you start a small weekly contribution of any amount through March 5 ONLY to help our campaign in this critical homestretch?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2342?c0=jan2024_abs_em_recurring.oXNDfC&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240111_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=5004%2E5257348%2EpPRd1n)**
That is also why I’ve been on the road for the past year — meeting incredible people across the state of California and hearing their priorities.
It would be the honor of my life to represent the people of California in the U.S. Senate. To be the leader you deserve, to advocate for affordable housing, to eradicate homelessness, to resist efforts by MAGA extremists to undermine our democracy, and to address other pressing issues.
To fight for fairness for families in the workforce.
To defend every Californian’s civil and reproductive rights.
To combat climate change.
To **get things done.**
I’m all-in, and I’m prepared to work even harder these next 54 days before Election Day to share our message.
But I can’t do it alone, Derek. I'm running in the most populous state in the nation, so my campaign will need a lot more resources and a robust grassroots team to come out on top.
One of the most impactful things you can do right now is to start a weekly donation. Recurring donations — even as little as $3 every month — help our team strategize effectively so we know how to allocate funds for advertising, target swing precincts, and advance to November.
**[So, will you start a weekly recurring donation to support my campaign for the U.S. Senate? I’m ready to fight for families all across California, but we need more resources to reach them before Primary Day on March 5.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2342?c0=jan2024_abs_em_recurring.oXNDfC&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240111_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=5004%2E5257348%2EpPRd1n)**

name: Hillsdale College via Pro Life Update
subject: These questions are at the core of what it means to be human
body:
“What is the good? What is the best way for man to live?”

| | | This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z9fuksq2dlgcqr8ioi486bhc60l5j0arr3sdbkq0_rp22sh2s8i6eo35c1g61or4cjh2bs)
Dear Fellow American, _“What is the good? What is the best way for man to live?”_ _“Does God exist? Can we know God?”_ These questions are at the core of what it means to be human - both in our relationship with each other and with God. Our Western heritage, tracing back to the Hebrews and the ancient Greeks, to Jerusalem and Athens, was where these questions were first asked, and answered. [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z7cma2i8a3s4psurhi5dcupvkauso31qdgom9ib0_rp22sh2s8i6eo35c1g61or4cjh2bs)Every Hillsdale College student is required to take a class on the Western heritage in order to graduate. And every academic year, I’m reminded of the joy it is to pursue the answers to such questions with my students. Today, I want to offer you that same experience... that same pursuit... that same joy... ... by sending you [**a limited-edition DVD box set of Hillsdale's popular online course, “Western Heritage - From the Book of Genesis to John Locke,”**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zbc7epmaqqi5777shj0hl30aatudphmfv3tkupd8_rp22sh2s8i6eo35c1g61or4cjh2bs) as a token of our thanks for a generous contribution in support of Hillsdale's efforts to educate America. This is your opportunity to deepen your understanding about the Golden Age of Greece, Early Christianity, the Renaissance, and the Scientific Revolution. It's your chance to plumb the depths of what makes Western civilization what it is today. And since we recently re-filmed and expanded this course - first offered in 2012 - to feature new lectures and professors, now is the perfect time to add it to your personal library, or give it as a gift. I invite you to study the history of the "big questions" with my colleagues and me. Reserve your DVD set now using this secure link, while they last: [**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/support-western-heritage-dvd**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zsjntvnr1hv64sutj1pb1v4go8f57t4gcao3mu4g_rp22sh2s8i6eo35c1g61or4cjh2bs) Warm regards, Larry P. This message is an opportunity to introduce myself.

| | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38922%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=p9sJ%2fQKhNxbnbF5y48DfEg&sysid=1)

**_“Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson.”_** When I heard that aloud for the first time it was truly a surreal experience. Even now, as I write it down I’m both humbled and thrilled. I am honored beyond imagination and completely understand how great of a responsibility it is to lead the House of Representatives on behalf of patriotic Americans like you. This message is an opportunity to introduce myself, and I’m truly grateful that you’re reading this right now - but before I tell you my story, I have a request: **_Firstly, would you pray for me?_** I’ve always believed in the power of prayer. That’s why I’m asking that you pray on my behalf that God would guide my hand and my gavel through my tenure as Speaker of the House. **_Secondly,[would you join Team Johnson?](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38923%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Zx4DuNTlY3gxzWa6ZEVDDQ&sysid=1) [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38922%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=p9sJ%2fQKhNxbnbF5y48DfEg&sysid=1)_**The House Republican Majority will soon be down to just a razor-thin margin and America is at a true crossroads. Will we submit and allow Democrats to take back the House in 2024, or will we fight back and expand our majority? **[To stand strong and fight back, we truly need your support.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38924%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZQ7BD5BWOkAPibaUGkXRYQ&sysid=1)** **[Even $1 could be the difference between Republican and Democrat Control.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38935%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=hr6DCY6y9tHIeYRxhoM%2fHw&sysid=1)** Growing up, my dad was a fireman. To me, he was Superman, and I wanted to be just like him. For the longest time I was set on serving my community as a firefighter -- but after my father was severely injured while on the job, he discouraged me from following in his footsteps. So I turned to my other passion of service: The Law. I was the first member of my family to earn a Bachelor’s degree. And just a few years later, I graduated from law school. I would go on to specialize in Constitutional Law and dedicate my career to defending religious liberty. I also founded a non-profit law firm to defend Christians against religious persecution. In 2016 I ran to become a member of the House of Representatives and WON. Since then, I’ve spent every day working to defend freedom for generations to come. I’ve spent the last 20 years on the front lines of the fight to defend our constitution, our country, and our faith. As long as there is breath in my lungs, I won’t stop fighting. Friend, I know you might have heard of me for the first time ever on the news just a few months ago. That’s why I wanted you to hear my story from me, directly, with no media talking heads between us. **[Now that you know a little more about me and what I stand for, I hope that you’ll join Team Johnson.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38936%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZjyQJSDUBJbNWWWhE6OLgQ&sysid=1)**

---
Thank you so much for your time and support, Friend. Sincerely,
---
[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38922%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=p9sJ%2fQKhNxbnbF5y48DfEg&sysid=1)

But Team Johnson can’t save America from the radical left and turn things around without the help of patriots like you. Democrats won’t stop doing everything in their power to stop us – regular hard-working Americans like you and me – from winning. Democrats don’t like us at all. | Listen, I’m not a politician. subject: Dangers of eating spinach
body:
Untitled Document

Please read the following message
from our sponsor.

Spinach is often promoted as a
healthy green, but contains FAR more downsides than good sides...

Spinach is one of the highest
oxalate foods that's commonly eaten by modern humans (in addition
to beet greens, beets, almonds, and other veggies and nuts).

The amount of oxalates in a
serving of spinach is extremely high, up to 600 mg in a normal
sized bowl. The "safe" amount of oxalates in a daily diet
according to world renowned oxalate expert Sally Norton should be
between 100-200 mg per day total to avoid a lot of the health
problems caused by high oxalate plants.

So you can see how concerning
spinach is with these extremely high oxalate levels.

The problem with eating too much
oxalates too frequently is that it can cause serious issues such
as kidney stones, thyroid problems, gut damage, skin issues, and
joint pain.

In fact, some people have even
gotten "oxalate poisoning" by drinking green smoothies too often
and had to go to the ER for kidney failure.

In addition, the nutrients in
spinach such as calcium and iron are very poorly absorbed by the
human body, with a dismal 3-4% bioavailability. Compare that to
the very high bioavailability (high absorption) of nutrients like
iron and calcium in meat and dairy at 30-40% bioavailability.

Overall, I believe that spinach
has more cons than pros, and I avoid it. Dozens of my clients
and friends have also reported dramatically improved digestion
and less joint pain when eliminating leafy greens such as
spinach.

More problems with a particular
common vegetable below that could be damaging your gut and
hormones...

Broccoli vs Kale vs Green
Beans... (the #1 WORST veggie for your gut & energy)
According to the best-selling
author and world-renowned heart surgeon, Dr. Steven Gundry,
there's one veggie people over 40 should never eat.

This veggie can damage your gut
and disrupt your hormones... It contains a toxin that damages the
lining of your intestines, causes bloating, embarrassing gas, and
a bulging belly.

talking about? Make sure you do by clicking the one below you
think it is, and get the answer from Dr. Gundry himself on the
next page:

>> Green Beans

disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Republican Party in the Virgin Islands
body:
Federal judge sides with Republicans.

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/493cd504ac7b/re-hey-9340217?e=d30db4cde8)
Fellow Republican,

I have some significant news.

The federal District Court ruled in favor of our party in a federal lawsuit that was filed in partnership with the Republican National Committee against the Supervisor of Elections and Democrat-run Board of Elections. Here's how the story was covered in today's newspaper (https://www.virginislandsdailynews.com/news/republicans-win-lawsuit-against-elections-system-judge-rules-some-election-laws-unconstitutional/article_b2a72275-2117-500b-99cc-939ee28dc3ac.html) :

In short, the chief judge struck down major provisions of V.I. elections law as unconstitutional. As you may recall, the Democrat-run Board of Elections has been weaponized in recent years to keep the Republican Party from effectively competing at the ballot box.

The court ruling is a huge step toward free, fair, and open elections within a two-party system.

Huge thanks to RNC Chairman Ronna McDaniel. This victory was only possible because she has been a tremendous partner for our local party over.

Meanwhile, it’s full steam ahead for the 2024 Virgin Islands caucus on February 8.

Voting locations and hours
St. Croix: 7 a.m. to 6 p.m. Atlantic at La Reine Chicken Shack, Christiansted
St. John: 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. Atlantic at Lovango Rum Bar, Cruz Bay
St. Thomas: 7 a.m. to 6 p.m. Atlantic at Bluebeard's Castle, Estate Taarneberg, Charlotte Amalie
The other day, the official candidate list was released by the independent Caucus Committee. You can get all the latest information through the official caucus website (https://www.republicanpartyinthevirginislands.com/2024-virgin-islands-caucus) . The website also has the application form (https://aa04c11e-819e-470f-8057-350d8850110d.usrfiles.com/ugd/aa04c1_76b83d8aba124cb79f409c5f35eabf7a.pdf) for anyone interested in being a delegate or alternate delegate at the 2024 Republican National Convention in Milwaukee.

With Iowa just days ahead and New York a week later, presidential campaigns will likely visit our islands between January 24 and February 8.

I will do my best to advise of you upcoming political events. But you shouldn’t be surprised if you start receiving phone calls, emails, texts, or mailers from the individual campaigns.

If you’re interested in volunteering or otherwise getting involved in a campaign, let me know and I’ll connect you.

Don't forget to also make plans to be on St. Thomas for our big Election Night Party at Morningstar, Frenchman's Reef. Admission is free with doors opening at 6:30 p.m. Just reply to this email and I'll save you a ticket for drinks and food.

Forward,
Republican Chairman Gordon Ackley

Peter,
Workers deserve to get paid for every hour and every penny they earn – It’s a fundamental American promise, not to mention common sense.
Yet far too often, I hear stories of Minnesotans getting hours shaved off their paychecks, being forced to work off the clock, getting denied overtime pay, having employers try to pay them in gift cards, and being ripped off in so many other ways.
Wage theft is theft – pure and simple. But even though we prosecute people who steal from other people or companies, it’s been historically difficult to hold bad employers accountable for stealing wages from their workers.
That’s why, in 2019, I created a dedicated Wage Theft unit in the Attorney General’s Office with the sole purpose of rooting out wage theft and making sure all Minnesota workers are getting paid what they earn.
As a result of this initiative, our office took action this week against an employer that not only failed to pay at least $3 million in earned wages but illegally charged rent for substandard housing and maintained a culture of fear and violence to discourage reporting, too.
This is a big step toward justice for these workers, and it wouldn’t be possible without you and this grassroots movement we’ve built together, which is why I wanted to remind you that Minnesota’s Political Contribution Refund (PCR) program reset and increased on January 1.

During our first campaign, millions of people made small, individual donations to help us take back the White House, protect our democracy, and begin the process of moving our country forward. So far in this race, hundreds of thousands of people have given to help us defeat Donald Trump or whoever the Republicans nominate in this race. We need you to join them. Let us explain: MAGA Republicans and their allied organizations are spending millions and millions of dollars to attack Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. They are doing it on television, online, and more. And they’re building organizing infrastructure that they’ll be able to use in this election year. That gives them a bit of a head start, and we need to catch up. Like last campaign, the single greatest source of individual donations to our campaign is the response to emails like this one. Now, we don't expect you to donate to each and every one of our emails. Hey Peter, Harry Dunn here.
This is a tough email to start – how do you talk about one of the darkest days of your life? Not to mention, an irreparable stain on this country's history.
So I guess I'll start with a question. Is this America?
Is attacking Capitol police officers – honest, good people dedicated to protecting and serving democracy – with baseball bats and spears, spraying them with WD-40, calling them hateful slurs – is that America?
Is a President of the United States emboldening a riot on the Capitol, encouraging people threatening to kill former Speaker Nancy Pelosi, former Vice President Mike Pence, who traveled to Washington ready to act on those threats – is that America?
**That's not American to me.** I believe in an America that protects its people, regardless of their political beliefs. An America that values democracy and those that are chosen to represent it. That's what I believed in while I served as a Capitol police officer during the January 6 insurrection.

Peter, as a former national security official sanctioned by Vladimir Putin for calling out his authoritarian regime, I’ve made a career out of standing up to spineless strongmen.
