[_**You may have already read emails from us and know what our campaign is all about. If you do, I hope you’ll take a second to split $5 between my campaign and Fight for Progress.**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76915022/448778914/-887798292?refcode=BLU_EM_FFP_2024-01-11_1&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjk5YmQ4ZTA4LWE2YjAtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyMzdkYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=GekEJMKZX3pETINmFobKVEC-Xsc3xDF_KcDXK2t4l7M=)

| **Ashcroft threatens to keep President Biden off MO ballot**
Secretary of State Jay Ashcroft said in a Jan. 6 social media post that Missouri and other Republican-led states should keep President Joe Biden off the ballot this year if the U.S. Supreme Court rules former President Donald Trump is ineligible to again seek the office under the Insurrection Clause of the 14th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution. Ashcroft, a Republican, cited no legal justification for excluding Biden, a Democrat, from the ballot this November and lacks the authority under state law to do so even if there was one.

Officials in Colorado and Maine have concluded the Insurrection Clause prevents Trump, a Republican, from appearing on presidential ballots in those states due to his role in fomenting the Jan. 6, 2021, attack on the U.S. Capitol as part of his failed attempt to remain in office after losing the 2020 election to Biden. The Insurrection Clause bars anyone who has taken an oath to uphold the Constitution and subsequently “engaged in insurrection or rebellion against” the United States from again holding public office. The conservative-dominated Supreme Court has agreed to hear Trump’s appeal of Colorado’s decision.

In a post on Twitter, now officially known as X, Ashcroft said: “What has happened in Colorado & Maine is disgraceful & undermines our republic. While I expect the Supreme Court to overturn this, if not, Secretaries of State will step in & ensure the new legal standard for (Trump) applies equally to (Biden).” In subsequent media interviews, Ashcroft reaffirmed his position that he could unilaterally keep Biden off of Missouri’s ballot.

In a Jan. 8 interview on CNN, Ashcroft struggled to come up with a legal justification for excluding Biden from the ballot when pressed by anchor Boris Sanchez. At one point Ashcroft said, referring to Biden, that there are “allegations that he engaged in insurrection,” but Ashcroft could not back up his claim with any allegation and ended up shouting at Sanchez.

As secretary of state, Ashcroft oversees elections in the state but has no authority to unilaterally remove a candidate from the ballot. In fact, as the Missouri Independent noted in a Jan. 11 story, the Missouri Court of Appeals Western District ruled in 2014 that secretary of state can’t even strike a candidate from the ballot who isn’t legally qualified to run for office unless a court first orders the removal.

In the intervening day between the original post and the CNN interview, Ashcroft and his family were victims of a “swatting” incident when Jefferson City police arrived at their home after receiving a false report of a shooting. No one was harmed as a result of the Jan. 7 incident, and the St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported police are continuing to investigate it. Making a false police report is a class B misdemeanor punishable by up to six months in jail and a $1,000 fine.
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| **House committee hears bill to further weaken state gun laws** The House General Laws Committee on Jan. 9 heard Republican legislation that would further weaken Missouri’s already lax gun laws to allow firearms to be carried on mass transit and in churches, expand conceal-carry rights to 18-year-olds and restore conceal-carry rights to people who pleaded guilty to certain crimes, including violent misdemeanors. All of those proposals have cleared the House of Representatives in recent years in various forms but failed to win Senate approval.

Under existing law, concealed weapons are prohibited on public buses and light rail, and also in houses of worship without the permission of church officials. House Bill 1708 would lift those prohibitions for people with a conceal-carry permit, although the bill’s sponsor said church leaders could still bar guns on church property by posting a sign declaring that weapons aren’t allowed. Firearms would still be prohibited on Amtrak trains.

Other provisions of HB 1708 would lower the minimum age for applying for a concealed weapons permit from 19 to 18, lift the prohibition on obtaining a conceal-carry permit for people who have pleaded guilty or no contest to certain crimes, and authorize retired judges and current or former lawmakers who are permit-holders to carry weapons in places where guns are otherwise prohibited by law.

The committee also heard separate legislation, House Bill 2291, that would exempt guns and ammunition from all state and local sales taxes. Democrats on the panel noted that under the bill necessities like food would still be taxed but weapons and ammunition would not. The bill’s fiscal estimate says it would cost the state about $31 million a year in lost revenue and local governments up to $65.4 million annually. The committee took no immediate action on either HB 2291 or HB 1708.
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| **House panel considers public school open enrollment**
The House Elementary and Secondary Education Committee on Jan. 10 heard legislation that would authorize children to transfer to public school districts other than the one in which they reside. The committee took no immediate action on the bill.

Under House Bill 1989, the open enrollment program would begin with the 2025-2026 school year. As currently written, while districts largely couldn’t stop students from transferring, participation would be voluntary among receiving districts. However, skeptics of the legislation are concerned that if open enrollment becomes law, the voluntary nature of the program wouldn’t long last as lawmakers would be under pressure to require districts to accept transfers.

Proponents of the bill say open enrollment would expand the public school options available to Missouri children and their families. Since the tax dollars would follow a student from his or her home district to the receiving district, opponents says it would shift resources from less wealthy districts to the more affluent ones that students are likely seek to transfer to under the bill, putting further financial strain on struggling school systems.

Capitol Ave., Rm 329 Jefferson City, MO 65101 (573) 751-4415 Steve.Roberts@senate.mo.gov | | | | | | | | | | | | Ashcroft threatens to keep President Biden off MO ballot Secretary of State Jay Ashcroft said in a Jan. 6 social media post that Missouri and other Republican-led states should keep President Joe Biden off the ballot this year if the U.S. Supreme Court rules former President Donald Trump is ineligible to again seek the office under the Insurrection Clause of the 14th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution. Ashcroft, a Republican, cited no legal justification for excluding Biden, a Democrat, from the ballot this November and lacks the authority under state law to do so even if there was one. Officials in Colorado and Maine have concluded the Insurrection Clause prevents Trump, a Republican, from appearing on presidential ballots in those states due to his role in fomenting the Jan. 6, 2021, attack on the U.S. Capitol as part of his failed attempt to remain in office after losing the 2020 election to Biden. The Insurrection Clause bars anyone who has taken an oath to uphold the Constitution and subsequently “engaged in insurrection or rebellion against” the United States from again holding public office. The conservative-dominated Supreme Court has agreed to hear Trump’s appeal of Colorado’s decision. In a post on Twitter, now officially known as X, Ashcroft said: “What has happened in Colorado & Maine is disgraceful & undermines our republic. While I expect the Supreme Court to overturn this, if not, Secretaries of State will step in & ensure the new legal standard for (Trump) applies equally to (Biden).” In subsequent media interviews, Ashcroft reaffirmed his position that he could unilaterally keep Biden off of Missouri’s ballot. In a Jan. 8 interview on CNN, Ashcroft struggled to come up with a legal justification for excluding Biden from the ballot when pressed by anchor Boris Sanchez. At one point Ashcroft said, referring to Biden, that there are “allegations that he engaged in insurrection,” but Ashcroft could not back up his claim with any allegation and ended up shouting at Sanchez. As secretary of state, Ashcroft oversees elections in the state but has no authority to unilaterally remove a candidate from the ballot. In fact, as the Missouri Independent noted in a Jan. 11 story, the Missouri Court of Appeals Western District ruled in 2014 that secretary of state can’t even strike a candidate from the ballot who isn’t legally qualified to run for office unless a court first orders the removal. In the intervening day between the original post and the CNN interview, Ashcroft and his family were victims of a “swatting” incident when Jefferson City police arrived at their home after receiving a false report of a shooting. No one was harmed as a result of the Jan. 7 incident, and the St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported police are continuing to investigate it. Making a false police report is a class B misdemeanor punishable by up to six months in jail and a $1,000 fine. | | | | House committee hears bill to further weaken state gun laws The House General Laws Committee on Jan. 9 heard Republican legislation that would further weaken Missouri’s already lax gun laws to allow firearms to be carried on mass transit and in churches, expand conceal-carry rights to 18-year-olds and restore conceal-carry rights to people who pleaded guilty to certain crimes, including violent misdemeanors. All of those proposals have cleared the House of Representatives in recent years in various forms but failed to win Senate approval. Under existing law, concealed weapons are prohibited on public buses and light rail, and also in houses of worship without the permission of church officials. House Bill 1708 would lift those prohibitions for people with a conceal-carry permit, although the bill’s sponsor said church leaders could still bar guns on church property by posting a sign declaring that weapons aren’t allowed. Firearms would still be prohibited on Amtrak trains. Other provisions of HB 1708 would lower the minimum age for applying for a concealed weapons permit from 19 to 18, lift the prohibition on obtaining a conceal-carry permit for people who have pleaded guilty or no contest to certain crimes, and authorize retired judges and current or former lawmakers who are permit-holders to carry weapons in places where guns are otherwise prohibited by law. The committee also heard separate legislation, House Bill 2291, that would exempt guns and ammunition from all state and local sales taxes. Democrats on the panel noted that under the bill necessities like food would still be taxed but weapons and ammunition would not. The bill’s fiscal estimate says it would cost the state about $31 million a year in lost revenue and local governments up to $65.4 million annually. The committee took no immediate action on either HB 2291 or HB 1708. | | | | House panel considers public school open enrollment The House Elementary and Secondary Education Committee on Jan. 10 heard legislation that would authorize children to transfer to public school districts other than the one in which they reside. The committee took no immediate action on the bill. Under House Bill 1989, the open enrollment program would begin with the 2025-2026 school year. As currently written, while districts largely couldn’t stop students from transferring, participation would be voluntary among receiving districts. However, skeptics of the legislation are concerned that if open enrollment becomes law, the voluntary nature of the program wouldn’t long last as lawmakers would be under pressure to require districts to accept transfers. Proponents of the bill say open enrollment would expand the public school options available to Missouri children and their families. Since the tax dollars would follow a student from his or her home district to the receiving district, opponents says it would shift resources from less wealthy districts to the more affluent ones that [1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

In case you missed it, yesterday we announced the newest Justice Democrat
to join our slate of young, diverse, working-class progressive champions
in Congress: Rep. Delia Ramirez of Illinois’ 3rd District.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240111.6Z01mK&refcode=em20240111-32774&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=32774%2E1203867%2ETiISYh ]The Intercept: Justice Democrats Endorses Chicago Progressive Among
First To Call For Gaza Ceasefire

This is our first endorsement of the 2024 election cycle, and it goes to
show that in spite of AIPAC’s plans to spend $100 million against the
Squad this year, our progressive movement keeps growing — and that’s
directly because of people like you.

As The Intercept noted, “The choice to back Ramirez signals that Justice
Democrats is doubling down its support for congressional progressives who
won’t cave to the pro-Israel lobby, even as they face an onslaught of
spending by groups like the American Israel Public Affairs Committee, or
AIPAC.”

AIPAC may be spending an unprecedented amount of right-wing mega-donor
money to unseat the Squad and squash our fight for peace and human rights
for Palestinians, but we’re not going to let that stop us or slow us down.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240111.6Z01mK&refcode=em20240111-32774&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1002&akid=32774%2E1203867%2ETiISYh ]We’re giving it our all to re-elect Justice Democrats like Delia and
the rest of the Squad this year: will you fuel our fight by pitching in
$3 or more today?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240111.6Z01mK&refcode=em20240111-32774&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1021&akid=32774%2E1203867%2ETiISYh ]Contribute $3

Thanks for making this work possible,

Geoff Simpson
Campaigns Director

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in
Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a
ceasefire through [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139873?t=1022&akid=32774%2E1203867%2ETiISYh ]Adalah Justice Project’s petition or by calling them
using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1023&akid=32774%2E1203867%2ETiISYh ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

In this episode of Navigating Uncertainty, Dr. Mansharamani speaks with **Rob Portman** , a dedicated public servant who has served America for more than three decades as a **Senator, Director of the Office of Management and Budget, US Trade Representative, and Congressman**. Senator Portman shares the story of working at a family business while growing up and how his love of the outdoors led him to Dartmouth (and kayaking down the Yangtze River!). He also shares his optimism (despite--or perhaps because of?--his time in Washington) that government can actually work for Americans if we restore our focus on finding common ground. The episode concludes with Senator Portman offering fabulous advice on how to navigate uncertainty: **Find your North Star and don 't let the cross-currents of uncertainty prevent you from making progress**.

Fellow American,
I hope your New Year is off to a great start!
Our campaign is already running hard - preparing for the petition gathering period that is less than two weeks away and adding new volunteers to our team every day. If you would like to join the team and help us get the signatures we need to start the process of beating Susan Wild, I hope you will check out the information included below and sign up today. The support of local leaders, important conservative groups, and countless donors has been overwhelming. I can’t thank them all enough for their support. I’m proud to have earned the endorsement of GOPAC - on of our nation’s leading conservative organizations. Here is the press release they sent out announcing their support...
WASHINGTON, DC – Chairman David Avella released the following statement on Pennsylvania State Representative Ryan Mackenzie earning the endorsement of GOPAC’s Mission Majority in his campaign for the Republican nomination in the 7th Congressional District.
“GOPAC supported Ryan Mackenzie in his first election to the Pennsylvania House and watched him build a record as a thoughtful, pragmatic conservative. He has earned our endorsement in his congressional campaign by championing ideas to advance Americans’ personal and economic security. With each election cycle, Congress gains more Members who have been involved in GOPAC’s mission. Ryan will be a valuable addition and will strengthen our majority in the U.S. House.”
About GOPAC: The GOPAC network invested nearly $32 million to educate and elect Republican leaders in the 2021-2022 election cycle. The Washington Post reported that GOPAC ranked 4th nationally amongst organizations donating directly to Republican candidates and committees.###
Recently, I had the opportunity to sit down and engage in a meaningful conversation with Chairman Avella. We discussed the significance of PA-7 and its impact on our community. This dialogue emphasized the importance of collaboration and understanding in achieving our shared goals.

body:

Happy New Year!

For many of us, the election of 2022 was a profound disappointment. In the spirit of living in the World as it is and not as we wish it to be, let us continue to press on and work to make our country, states, and cities the best they can be.

I am continuing to speak and promote common-sense policies, a return to American energy dominance, and the importance of countering our greatest adversaries Russia and China.

Last week America First Policy Institute (AFPI) held its first-ever Twitter space on energy and we were joined by some of the smartest leading advocates on sound energy policy.

I have recently written two op-eds on energy policy. One, on the government's overreach in attempting to ban gas stoves (https://carlasands.com/banning-gas-stoves-thats-too-many-government-cooks-in-your-kitchen/) in the United States, and the other, on the impact of wealthy western countries, including the U.S., attempts to prevent African nations (https://www.shorenewsnetwork.com/2022/12/16/carla-sands-lets-hope-african-leaders-will-see-through-the-biden-admins-anti-prosperity-agenda/) from prospering and industrializing by withholding the benefits of fossil fuel usage.

Next month, I will be speaking in Panama about "Why emerging economies should choose the U.S. over the CCP as their trading partner of choice.".

As we enter the New Year, I am thinking a lot about Freedom of Speech and how essential it is to preserve our constitutional rights and our "republic if you can keep it" as Ben Franklin famously said upon exiting the Constitutional Convention of 1787.

Keep the Faith,
Carla Sands
US Ambassador to the Kingdom of Denmark (ret.)

In 2021, the radical Left was riding high and Washington elites were confident that the America First movement was finished. They could not be more wrong.

body:
Hello,

My name is Dan Lampman, I've recently started working with Dr Horne as his campaign manager in CD-01. I've been getting caught up on sign ups to our contact form and I came across your submission from a while back.

I wanted to introduce myself and follow up about how you can get involved to help us flip this district. There are several ways to get involved in our volunteering opportunities! Right now our main focus is collecting petition signatures and spreading the word about Andrew's candidacy. We have volunteers canvassing, organizing events, and helping with community outreach.

I would love to connect with you to talk more about how to get involved! Let me know if you have some time soon to chat.

Thanks for reaching out and I'm looking forward to hearing from you!

Best,

\--

Dan Lampman

I'm tired of Washington doing nothing while **millions of illegal immigrants trample over our country's immigration laws**.

We have a tough primary coming up on March 5 against well-funded opponents._We don't need to out raise them, but I can't win without conservative patriots like you on my side._

subject: Moment to talk?
body:
I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support.

---

Friend,

Since the moment I got off the stage, I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future.

Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/VB_A-0-BtQRvAEey9mIhTQ~~/AARclAA~-7mZjUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~ "Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
---
| | | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/VB_A-0-BtQRvAEey9mIhTQ~~/AARclAA~-7mZjUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _
---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️**
---
| | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/VB_A-0-BtQRvAEey9mIhTQ~~/AARclAA~-7mZjUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)
---
It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

---
| [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/VB_A-0-BtQRvAEey9mIhTQ~~/AARclAA~-7mZjUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)
---

Now, I'm running for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class.

**[It would mean a lot to me if every single person _reading this today_ could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG! >>](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/VB_A-0-BtQRvAEey9mIhTQ~~/AARclAA~-7mZjUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~ "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG! >>")**

Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days.

**[Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/VB_A-0-BtQRvAEey9mIhTQ~~/AARclAA~-7mZjUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~ "Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?")**

---
| | [RUSH SUPPORT TODAY](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/VB_A-0-BtQRvAEey9mIhTQ~~/AARclAA~-7mZjUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)
---

Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, **[I need your help- starting right now.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/VB_A-0-BtQRvAEey9mIhTQ~~/AARclAA~-7mZjUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~ "I need your help – starting right now. ")**

Your contribution is what keeps this movement alive and thriving, so thank you for standing with me.

My very best,

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

| More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

| Today is my father’s birthday, and to celebrate the day and him, I continue to work hard — day in and day out — for the Virginians I serve. It may sound cheesy, but the truth is that it is my father — a veteran and career law enforcement officer — who instilled in me a deep devotion to our country and an abiding commitment to service.

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _
---

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

clean_body: I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. | | | | | | Friend, Since the moment I got off the stage, I wanted to let you know how grateful I am for your support. Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future. Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. "Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!" Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️ | | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! I refuse to stand by and watch. I’m prepared to fight to protect our rights, our fragile democracy – and to be honest, I’m prepared to win.

That’s where everyday Americans like you come in:
$5 will help me have a vote to protect and expand voting and reproductive rights.

Peter, before we know it, this election will be here – and the stakes are getting higher every day. Can I ask you to come on board our team and pitch in $5 to my campaign today?
Don’t just take it from me. Let’s run through it.
CNN has ranked Pennsylvania as one of the most likely Senate seats to flip in 2024, and Mitch McConnell said that we’re one of his top targets.
My friend James Carville predicts that if we lose here, we’ll lose the Senate _and_ the White House.
And my mega-millionaire opponent has the resources to self-fund his campaign. That’s on top of the super PAC support he’s already been promised.
If you’re ready to help us meet this moment, you can chip in any amount at this link: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240111-1?refcode=em20240111-1](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240111-1?refcode=em20240111-1&refcode2=1677_552475_gRlfO8&akid=1677%2E552475%2EgRlfO8)**
Now that it’s 2024, there’s simply no room for error. With an open seat in West Virginia, Mitch McConnell only needs to flip one more to retake the Senate, and he’s laser-focused on PA.
That’s why it’s so important we have the resources to withstand the tsunami of dark money that’s headed our way. Please, if you can, chip in $5 or more today: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240111-1?refcode=em20240111-1](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240111-1?refcode=em20240111-1&refcode2=1677_552475_gRlfO8&akid=1677%2E552475%2EgRlfO8)**
Pennsylvania is gearing up to be the most competitive and expensive race on the map, but with your support, I know we can keep this seat and our Senate majority in Democratic hands.
With gratitude,
Bob Casey

| | Dear Peter,

The cherished Land and Water Conservation Fund – which has done so much to protect redwood forests and other treasured landscapes over the years – is under threat again. Less than three years after the passage of the Great American Outdoors Act assured permanent funding for the LWCF, there comes a move in the U.S. Senate to redirect $100 million in funding meant for land protection, clean water, climate mitigation, and wildlife habitat for other purposes.

We need you to let your senators know that you want to keep these dedicated dollars in the Land and Water Conservation Fund, and that you oppose this rescission. **[Send your email right now.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/76926818/448814339/209381099?emci=26cbd201-b6b0-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&emdi=704e1b83-bcb0-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&contactdata=80dvj58aSh7G6esiGduYq2HuiLLD9GlbQaRLtyVnsif7pVrBDoVSI1Mf8CKGt2Ej2QQNCu2jh/J/nQFi9Blltg8QogkpM33VsVVUyoV1hvu5EjEWYy3Vm/AtpOYUYLZqXfsUR5aDoxv2iiDgkXyiZ3K8Vlg+/ub51QxHyAgk2ac=&utm_campaign=action-lwcf2024&utm_source=ea-aa&utm_medium=email&sourceid=1165232&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjcwNGUxYjgzLWJjYjAtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyMzdkYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=iHZIlyPliHABoVKV1yGt5M2bsnM9AyeeS6-qj5Gf4NU=&ceid=1504551)**

This latest move to redirect funding from the LWCF comes from Senate Interior Appropriations Committee which recently passed the $100 million rescission of LWCF funding in its FY24 Interior Appropriations Bill. We need to stop this move before it gains traction. The Land and Water Conservation Fund has been one of America’s most useful and cost-effective conservation programs, using oil drilling revenue instead of taxpayer funds. Muir Woods National Monument and Sequoia and Kings Canyon National Parks have been enhanced thanks to this funding source, and League projects like Mailliard Ranch, Red Hill, and Alder Creek in Giant Sequoia National Monument, Freshwater Ridge near Redwood National Park, and the Westfall property adjacent to Headwaters Forest Reserve have all relied on LWCF funding.

| _**“Huge waves will keep battering California in January. Climate change is making them worse”**_

**\- USA Today**

It's true. Our beloved Golden State is facing a serious environmental challenge. In January alone, we’ve witnessed ocean waves reaching staggering heights of up to 16 feet, causing alarm for residents and visitors to CA’s coastal cities.

As a result of climate change, we're seeing a disturbing trend of rising sea levels and more frequent, aggressive coastal erosion. This is not just an environmental issue — it impacts every Californian. Our homes, infrastructure, and very way of life are at risk.

I refuse to stand by idly, and I believe you share this sentiment.

That's why I'm reaching out to you today. We are in a climate emergency, and we need bold action NOW.

#
---
Peter, In her first year as governor, Tina stood by her promise to visit all 36 counties in Oregon. She connected with folks across the state to understand local concerns and how she can better partner with communities to solve problems together. We’re excited to share a part of her journey. **Here are some reflections from the One Oregon Listening Tour!** **_Housing and Homelessness in Oregon:_ **Tina has made it a priority to address the housing crisis in Oregon and is determined to make sure communities have more housing in the coming year and beyond. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76927204/448815650/-1155711491?refcode=AU_TK_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240111_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZDU1ODFlOS1iY2IwLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ze8lRoG7SoXQ6HowSsuNkxXVz7j_7qHtFetAcApBlKQ=)_In John Day, Tina examines plans to build new homes using 3D printing manufacturing technology._ | [WATCH VIDEO ON HOUSING](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76927206/448815653/-1155711491?refcode=AU_TK_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240111_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZDU1ODFlOS1iY2IwLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ze8lRoG7SoXQ6HowSsuNkxXVz7j_7qHtFetAcApBlKQ=)
---
_**Mental Health and Addiction Services:**_ Tina spent time with community leaders to learn about barriers to accessing mental health care and addiction services throughout the state.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76927207/448815656/-1155514883?refcode=AU_TK_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240111_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZDU1ODFlOS1iY2IwLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ze8lRoG7SoXQ6HowSsuNkxXVz7j_7qHtFetAcApBlKQ=)_In Prairie City, the Governor signed the AgriStress Hotline bill that helps local farmers, fishermen, and ranchers talk about their mental health concerns._
[WATCH VIDEO ON MENTAL HEALTH](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76927208/448815657/-1155514883?refcode=AU_TK_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240111_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZDU1ODFlOS1iY2IwLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ze8lRoG7SoXQ6HowSsuNkxXVz7j_7qHtFetAcApBlKQ=)
---
**_Education and Childcare:_ **Tina's committed to making sure every family in Oregon has access to affordable childcare and quality education.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76927209/448815662/-1155645955?refcode=AU_TK_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240111_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZDU1ODFlOS1iY2IwLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ze8lRoG7SoXQ6HowSsuNkxXVz7j_7qHtFetAcApBlKQ=)_In Woodburn, Tina holds a roundtable with educators to learn more about their summer programs and discussing how to implement them statewide._
[WATCH VIDEO ON EDUCATION](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76927210/448815673/-1155645955?refcode=AU_TK_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240111_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZDU1ODFlOS1iY2IwLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ze8lRoG7SoXQ6HowSsuNkxXVz7j_7qHtFetAcApBlKQ=)
---
**Tina’s big takeaway is this: Oregonians all want the same things. They care about access to mental health and addiction resources, housing, and good schools. Now, it’s time to work together and make our state a better place for everyone to succeed. **
As always, thank you, Peter. Tina continues to work hard to make progress on the issues we all care about, and she’s grateful to know she has your support.
— Team Tina
Tina for Oregon
PO Box 42307
Portland, OR 97242 **[tinafororegon.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/76927211/448815680/1133357015?refcode=AU_TK_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240111_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZDU1ODFlOS1iY2IwLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Ze8lRoG7SoXQ6HowSsuNkxXVz7j_7qHtFetAcApBlKQ=&emci=b87a4c3a-16ac-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&emdi=ad5581e9-bcb0-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&ceid=15353729) | [info@tinafororegon.com](mailto:info@tinafororegon.com)** | Paid for by Friends of Tina Kotek

[](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/35797?t=7&akid=20628%2E4449941%2EG8aDUf) [**I’m writing because I want you to split $7 or whatever you can (or more than you can) between Fight for Reform and my friend Josh Riley to help him win one of the most important races in the country in 2024.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/35797?t=8&akid=20628%2E4449941%2EG8aDUf) Josh is running for Congress in New York’s 19th District, a key district to taking back the House. Here’s why I support Josh — and why you should too!

Josh knows policy issues backward and forward. Together Josh and I did good stuff when he was my counsel on the U.S. Senate Judiciary Committee – good stuff like protecting victims of domestic violence.

In the Violence Against Women Act, Josh and I wrote a provision that protected survivors of domestic violence from homelessness. **And Josh and I got that protection through a divided Senate, a Republican House, and signed into law.**

Republicans lie and say Josh was bad on crime, but here’s the truth. Josh and I advanced legislation _that funded the police_! Providing bullet-proof vests for local and state police. And funding crisis intervention training to teach police officers how to de-escalate situations.

**_Together in the Senate, we also made a lot of Republican witnesses look very bad at hearings when we cross-examined them._**

Josh really, really cares about all the stuff I care about. And he is the hardest worker I know.

And finally, NY-19 is considered a tossup and one of the most competitive in the nation. [**So, what do you say? Will you join me by splitting a contribution between Fight for Reform and Josh’s campaign today?**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/35797?t=9&akid=20628%2E4449941%2EG8aDUf) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Fight for Reform and Josh Riley will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $7 »](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/35798?t=10&akid=20628%2E4449941%2EG8aDUf)

This is important to me. And to our nation.

Thanks,

Al

clean_body: We're with Lucy every step of the way. | = Peter, I'm so excited to announce that we've endorsed Rep. Lucy McBath (GA-06) for reelection this cycle. Lucy McBath is a lot of things: the daughter of civil rights activists, a working parent, a two-time cancer survivor, and, after tragically losing her son Jordan to gun violence in 2012, a tireless advocate for gun safety, community activism, and justice. = Because of her activism, Lucy has been targeted relentlessly by state and national Republicans. Just weeks ago, midway through the election cycle, Rep. McBath was forced to switch districts because the GOP-led Georgia legislature decimated her current district through redistricting. "I refuse to allow an extremist few Republicans to decide when my work in Congress is finished," Lucy said in a statement — and we at EMILYs List couldn't agree more. We're with Lucy every step of the way, and we believe she has what it takes to win — despite Republican efforts to undemocratically oust her from the House. **Peter, will you donate now to help elect and reelect women like Rep. body:

Peter Willis,

Artificial intelligence presents unique risks to the economic security and
dignity of the working class in America. And it’s no surprise that
Congress is behind the curve on placing regulations and safeguards around
AI in order to protect workers.

We need Congress to place a check on AI in the workplace before it
threatens wages and the dignity of work.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/13396?source=email-20240111&t=1011&akid=5175%2E5885482%2EUsbl2r ]Add your name: Protect workers from runaway corporate AI. We can’t let
artificial intelligence hurt working conditions and wages.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/13396?source=email-20240111&t=1012&akid=5175%2E5885482%2EUsbl2r ]ADD YOUR NAME

Recently, the Screen Actors Guild and Writers Guild of America were
striking to protect their job security and wages — and AI protections were
a central part of their grievances. Executives wanted to exploit actors
and writers using AI, but workers stood up and said NO.

AI has been impacting workplaces across sectors, and its impact will only
be felt more as time goes by. It’s time to protect workers in the new
digital age. And our lawmakers have a critical role to play.

Workers should have a decision-making role in how and when their companies
adopt technologies that will impact their jobs. Workers should receive
compensation based on profit from the implementation of these
technologies, not solely hours worked.

Congress is already behind on the issue of AI in the workplace. It’s time
for lawmakers to act.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/13396?source=email-20240111&t=1013&akid=5175%2E5885482%2EUsbl2r ]Add your name: Protect workers from runaway corporate AI!

Why? Because the moment I was elected Speaker by my Republican colleagues, the Radical Left IMMEDIATELY unleashed a coordinated, preplanned political hit job against me.
* The Liberal Media spun up hit piece after hit piece to smear me in the press - Biden's former Press Secretary even attacked me for being a Christian on MSNBC.
* Politico fired off this headline: _" Democrats rev up the opposition machine against Mike Johnson."_
* And I can't even begin to tell you how many Democrat fundraising emails and texts I saw in the minutes following the final vote - I'm bracing myself for the next FEC reports.

Look:

These vicious attacks are a dime a dozen in Washington. They don't intimidate me. _But I 'll let you in on a little secret: that's not _really_ the goal..._

The _real_ goal of this political ambush is two-fold: **1)** smear the good names of every House Republican to hurt them electorally, and **2)** scare Liberals enough to whip out their credit cards, fill in their info, and donate to Democrats.

**It 's about power and money. Nothing else.**

That's why it's mission-critical that we stand up for ourselves in critical moments like this. _**[So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I'm teaming up with my fellow Louisianian - Majority Leader Steve Scalise - to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.](http://links.electionsupdates.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=3f55d340b80746a3a8067ab6c938bbc9&_e=zA1ZHKaATO9tHqSZJamrevQKjaHefUb5ah-J0bmotkqM9BUSd0Ugcnq5HJDd1B_mYTmemGDCkB9-KBqxGwwaQgb0wgzmS1N2tqCPYhqMD1gBvG8G2umjdrDt71omJDdLwFriy6zNunjvDp8RKyApa-9UjlfCXe_ngXCQVVaHvkXRAD694PYK6d5z3hZOjSWWxjZDnyxnQrVXGgMzkEUkYw7xY4IDDe0zgiDUtfLdDThTDzNCkqzErYG3GIN557vSIoyQIvXky4M0aOj6acSi6Kx5jOTb0cm_9BJav095w9k6itayj_MaVoCn5eO9jQsLAkTIXtuxE2WSUHnRFL_dpoxiC87CfoCdd8DXFYkrqlbVMgDiZcNrUYbN3oZRJ-s-JjPmrTQ4C2Z1XBussTll2Gx8DhH4U-VNFoiQUtbeAOc%3D "So as one of my first moves as Speaker, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian – Majority Leader Steve Scalise – to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.")**_

It's ambitious. I get it. But that's the bare minimum we need to fully fund our campaign operations in battleground races across the country.

**If we fall short of that, we 'll be forced to SLASH our voter contact budgets, GUT our digital outreach efforts, and pull our ads OFF THE AIRWAVES. Nothing could be worse for our plans to defend and expand our slim House Majority.**

So here's my final pitch to you:

We urgently need your help. Not next week, not in the new year - right here and right now.

The difference between a strong Conservative Majority and one controlled by the Liberal Machine will come down to can't-miss fundraising goals just like this.

Let me make myself perfectly clear:

_I 'm not asking you to pitch in more than you can afford. If you can spare $50 or $100, I would be tremendously grateful. But if you can only spare $5 or $10, I would be equally appreciative._

_**[The ONLY thing I ask is for every Conservative in the country to chip in SOMETHING.](http://links.electionsupdates.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=3f55d340b80746a3a8067ab6c938bbc9&_e=zA1ZHKaATO9tHqSZJamrevQKjaHefUb5ah-J0bmotkqM9BUSd0Ugcnq5HJDd1B_mYTmemGDCkB9-KBqxGwwaQgb0wgzmS1N2tqCPYhqMD1gBvG8G2umjdrDt71omJDdLwFriy6zNunjvDp8RKyApa-9UjlfCXe_ngXCQVVaHvkXRAD694PYK6d5z3hZOjSWWxjZDnyxnQrVXGgMzkEUkYw7xY4IDDe0zgiDUtfLdDThTDzNCkqzErYG3GIN557vSIoyQIvXky4M0aOj6acSi6BO9X_Iag3re3EPzRbEt7sk_VdSJBLjXNFseNmaVe3b6p7erImoG-2EzBWxYsf2aPdasxLbavSSp3b2B0NLgbawx4-WtVtLrQIFbRovxIcGEZ4BPm3fO9RT1ZlRplDUobdHR2_cAp2YZScT8zST16ao%3D "The ONLY thing I ask is for every Conservative in the country to chip in SOMETHING.")**_

name: Dr. Paul Gosar
subject: Upholding the Rule of Law: Taking a Stand Against Corruption
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY GOSAR FOR CONGRESS
body:
| | | | I cast my vote to hold Hunter Biden in contempt of Congress | [](https://tk.paulgosaraz.com/ga/click/2-57929-1-20-36-28-b5769751b6-eud12776e1)
---
**Dear Fellow Patriot,**

Today, I am reaching out to share a crucial development in our ongoing commitment to uphold justice and integrity in our nation's governance.

**In a decisive move, I cast my vote to hold Hunter Biden in contempt of Congress**.

This action is in response to his deliberate disregard for a lawfully issued subpoena last month.

It is a fundamental principle that the rule of law applies equally to all, irrespective of status or connection, including high-profile figures like Joe Biden or his son, Hunter.

By willfully ignoring lawful subpoenas linked to his involvement in what appears to be a corruption scandal and abuse of power, Hunter Biden is, in essence, obstructing justice.

_A congressional subpoena, much like a court order, is not a mere request – it is a mandate_.

Ignoring such a directive should have serious ramifications. Yet, there is a troubling perception of a two-tiered justice system, where those accustomed to eluding legal repercussions perceive such mandates as inconsequential.

The connections between Joe Biden and Hunter’s questionable business dealings are increasingly evident, raising significant concerns. The American public deserves transparency and the truth.

**[Hunter Biden's decision to dismiss Congress's authority only heightens the need for accountability. He must be compelled to address questions regarding his exploitation of the Biden name for personal gain](https://tk.paulgosaraz.com/ga/click/2-57929-1-20-36-28-b5769751b6-eud12776e1)**.

Hunter Biden’s actions are nothing short of contempt of Congress, and it is only right that he faces prosecution, just as Trump associates like Steve Bannon and Peter Navarro did when they were found in contempt by the Biden Justice Department.

This is not merely a matter of political rivalry; it is a question of preserving the sanctity of our legal system and democratic processes. _As a nation, we cannot turn a blind eye to such blatant disregard for the law_.

Your support has always been the cornerstone of our endeavors to bring about meaningful change and uphold justice. Together, we can ensure that the rule of law remains the bedrock of our society, immune to the influence of power and privilege.

Thank you for standing with me in this fight for fairness and accountability.

**[Your continued backing is invaluable as we strive to reveal the truth and uphold the principles that our great nation was founded upon](https://tk.paulgosaraz.com/ga/click/2-57929-1-20-36-28-b5769751b6-eud12776e1).**

**For Freedom,**

Congressman Paul A. Gosar, D.D.S. | [ DONATE >> ](https://tk.paulgosaraz.com/ga/click/2-57929-1-20-36-28-b5769751b6-eud12776e1)

body:
Bill Eigel's proposal to increase transparency and allow two days to read legislation killed by establishment politicians | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/billeigel/rinos-and-democrats-hate-transparency?e=c00a6982d2)
---

| [Support Bill Eigel](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=ded1577394&e=c00a6982d2 "Support Bill Eigel")
---
| | **RINOs & Democrats Killed Eigel's Proposal to Read Bills before Voting**
* * *
**Democrat Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi once infamously remarked "you have to pass the bill so you can find out what's in it, away from the fog of controversy."**

**Passing bills without knowing what's in them is _UNACCEPTABLE_ to me. Unfortunately, that's exactly what establishment politicians in the Jefferson City Swamp do _ALL THE TIME_. Don't believe me? Here's what happened in the Senate this week.**

**Yesterday, RINOs and Democrats in the Missouri Senate killed my rule change to increase transparency and allow two days for Senators and the public to read bills before voting on them.

Establishment politicians spend way more time at cocktail parties with lobbyists than they do reading legislation and working on behalf of their constituents.

Senators admitted on the floor yesterday that they voted ‘yes’ on bills last session without reading them and STILL voted against my rule change to give Senators and the public more time to read the bills.

RINOs and Democrats teamed up to kill my proposal for something that was as simple as allowing sufficient time to read bills.

__The swamp is terrified that if they allow more time for the public to read bills, then they might not get the special interest junk they want passed. __

The Jefferson City Swamp is callous to the struggles of the everyday taxpayer and insistent on blindly passing harmful legislation without second thought. _This is wrong. __Jefferson City needs a reckoning._**
---

This message is an opportunity to introduce myself.
z
| | | [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ed2c649ce9604667a180b76b185b66e5&_e=LZrXeCMjrDp3vYQPqt1bBq_7h5oYXhS8OKcY-B0vEOz7pmgivo5I1_llVXRNGDLnPJV7Wex3JS_1U_-373BYyo4byhdw3wxlnGGTiqM3orIk_0BduKJxf97UHO6O7qq1BTXRfSFNiIRJUhyh5vyCW2jNPvIey351-6DrwnHfU-YYbdkseyQwFzm6EtmjAe1dPD_0izXgAcAl6oWF0YVAEBJ4ZMH8byVpB8F7itvOOH2p3qJylLaelu8nJ6FhixGd0Obd1AkI4ahXvwgZfd5yGZcq0ZMcwBcLgAGbl6NCd8yz09vLPJp0CLfKB5pz1weuCJxqVTp9P0RSP00KgPRwYkzGQa0NIxxWlsah45za15Sf-JyeB0w9TeX-ggejEwvvLTXNRHEuGKnB8SL0Ac_J4rqVT5K2kuX3V0fBjgHz5QHKgbWBylP1IJfBNE24NbA8)

**_" Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson."_** When I heard that aloud for the first time it was truly a surreal experience. Even now, as I write it down I'm both humbled and thrilled. I am honored beyond imagination and completely understand how great of a responsibility it is to lead the House of Representatives on behalf of patriotic Americans like you. This message is an opportunity to introduce myself, and I'm truly grateful that you're reading this right now - but before I tell you my story, I have a request: **_Firstly, would you pray for me?_** I've always believed in the power of prayer. That's why I'm asking that you pray on my behalf that God would guide my hand and my gavel through my tenure as Speaker of the House. **_Secondly,[would you join Team Johnson?](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ed2c649ce9604667a180b76b185b66e5&_e=LZrXeCMjrDp3vYQPqt1bBq_7h5oYXhS8OKcY-B0vEOz7pmgivo5I1_llVXRNGDLnPJV7Wex3JS_1U_-373BYyo4byhdw3wxlnGGTiqM3orIk_0BduKJxf97UHO6O7qq1BTXRfSFNiIRJUhyh5vyCW2jNPvIey351-6DrwnHfU-YYbdkseyQwFzm6EtmjAe1dPD_0izXgAcAl6oWF0YVAEBJ4ZMH8byVpB8F7itvOOH2p3qJylLaelu8nJ6FhixGd0Obd1AkI4ahXvwgZfd5yGZcq0ZMcwBcLgAGbl6NCd8yJ4Kxom6n5qRuMPOJCUMEoCz5gWMaY_zF29Bc7UzJvREIqyvt8_B_aWjh2UjL4lEF0uwr_yqFRa2NVdEQvCRovTuL9tLnz9Yu_stmOZj-CGJePiNzUHlA80claNtXjIYOWmEVHx_A5zGzfn2UC8AE0) [](Friend)_**The House Republican Majority will soon be down to just a razor-thin margin and America is at a true crossroads. Will we submit and allow Democrats to take back the House in 2024, or will we fight back and expand our majority? **[To stand strong and fight back, we truly need your support.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ed2c649ce9604667a180b76b185b66e5&_e=LZrXeCMjrDp3vYQPqt1bBq_7h5oYXhS8OKcY-B0vEOz7pmgivo5I1_llVXRNGDLnPJV7Wex3JS_1U_-373BYyo4byhdw3wxlnGGTiqM3orIk_0BduKJxf97UHO6O7qq1BTXRfSFNiIRJUhyh5vyCW2jNPvIey351-6DrwnHfU-YYbdkseyQwFzm6EtmjAe1dPD_0izXgAcAl6oWF0YVAEBJ4ZMH8byVpB8F7itvOOH2p3qJylLaelu8nJ6FhixGd0Obd1AkI4ahXvwgZfd5yGZcq0ZMcwBcLgAGbl6NCd8z6XHbCvqHy2cCBZGtJed0fh2TmqrjkDLGBQ6Q0VoxEhmV2GnK4aFyv5iLkYLXCyWjAPheJ401E42kL4TIg2f7-5s7wd1gWS5vdu-PmB8866nnmdCQMC_y5Yi4Jr__po4C6fuW6R2MQZlTGOqYntf8Z)** **[Even $1 could be the difference between Republican and Democrat Control.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ed2c649ce9604667a180b76b185b66e5&_e=LZrXeCMjrDp3vYQPqt1bBq_7h5oYXhS8OKcY-B0vEOz7pmgivo5I1_llVXRNGDLnPJV7Wex3JS_1U_-373BYyo4byhdw3wxlnGGTiqM3orIk_0BduKJxf97UHO6O7qq1BTXRfSFNiIRJUhyh5vyCW2jNPvIey351-6DrwnHfU-YYbdkseyQwFzm6EtmjAe1dPD_0izXgAcAl6oWF0YVAEBJ4ZMH8byVpB8F7itvOOH2p3qJylLaelu8nJ6FhixGd0Obd1AkI4ahXvwgZfd5yGZcq0ZMcwBcLgAGbl6NCd8wyKiAz_ctTtg1oBfrpcuydg20jyOjZ0iPl9r4ugWk0Zgkx9OQiBTlu3de_mDmsEJ6NRusUjlhdlPpi9E1n5DSyASsUj33quElWuUgRwJL0Neou6OkDH_dG6lOiL1xc3RCs0PphyR0WJsWoAzCJPST-)** Growing up, my dad was a fireman. To me, he was Superman, and I wanted to be just like him. For the longest time I was set on serving my community as a firefighter -- but after my father was severely injured while on the job, he discouraged me from following in his footsteps. So I turned to my other passion of service: The Law. I was the first member of my family to earn a Bachelor's degree. And just a few years later, I graduated from law school. I would go on to specialize in Constitutional Law and dedicate my career to defending religious liberty. I also founded a non-profit law firm to defend Christians against religious persecution. In 2016 I ran to become a member of the House of Representatives and WON. Since then, I've spent every day working to defend freedom for generations to come. I've spent the last 20 years on the front lines of the fight to defend our constitution, our country, and our faith. As long as there is breath in my lungs, I won't stop fighting. Friend, I know you might have heard of me for the first time ever on the news just a few months ago. That's why I wanted you to hear my story from me, directly, with no media talking heads between us. **[Now that you know a little more about me and what I stand for, I hope that you'll join Team Johnson.](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ed2c649ce9604667a180b76b185b66e5&_e=LZrXeCMjrDp3vYQPqt1bBq_7h5oYXhS8OKcY-B0vEOz7pmgivo5I1_llVXRNGDLnPJV7Wex3JS_1U_-373BYyo4byhdw3wxlnGGTiqM3orIk_0BduKJxf97UHO6O7qq1BTXRfSFNiIRJUhyh5vyCW2jNPvIey351-6DrwnHfU-YYbdkseyQwFzm6EtmjAe1dPD_0izXgAcAl6oWF0YVAEBJ4ZMH8byVpB8F7itvOOH2p3qJylLaelu8nJ6FhixGd0Obd1AkI4ahXvwgZfd5yGZcq0ZMcwBcLgAGbl6NCd8ww15hG1OifiCtcJFazgu_eW_KpBPhHIj8t4uCyns-9eDdaLmIGOVFg61ogslHxiAVmH2hYIYEy9EctQO6DVJSxGHD3aCNkXRHKm5EF7vU1LSdEH8YgdL0p51FUD752ZvVPle7okexdJETvcQiiSIAc)**

clean_body: This message is an opportunity to introduce myself. z | | | " Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson." When I heard that aloud for the first time it was truly a surreal experience. Even now, as I write it down I'm both humbled and thrilled. I am honored beyond imagination and completely understand how great of a responsibility it is to lead the House of Representatives on behalf of patriotic Americans like you. This message is an opportunity to introduce myself, and I'm truly grateful that you're reading this right now - but before I tell you my story, I have a request: Firstly, would you pray for me? I've always believed in the power of prayer. That's why I'm asking that you pray on my behalf that God would guide my hand and my gavel through my tenure as Speaker of the House. Secondly, FriendThe House Republican Majority will soon be down to just a razor-thin margin and America is at a true crossroads. Will we submit and allow Democrats to take back the House in 2024, or will we fight back and expand our majority? - Growing up, my dad was a fireman. To me, he was Superman, and I wanted to be just like him. For the longest time I was set on serving my community as a firefighter -- but after my father was severely injured while on the job, he discouraged me from following in his footsteps. So I turned to my other passion of service: The Law. I was the first member of my family to earn a Bachelor's degree. And just a few years later, I graduated from law school. I would go on to specialize in Constitutional Law and dedicate my career to defending religious liberty. I also founded a non-profit law firm to defend Christians against religious persecution. In 2016 I ran to become a member of the House of Representatives and WON. Since then, I've spent every day working to defend freedom for generations to come. I've spent the last 20 years on the front lines of the fight to defend our constitution, our country, and our faith. As long as there is breath in my lungs, I won't stop fighting. Friend, I know you might have heard of me for the first time ever on the news just a few months ago. That's why I wanted you to hear my story from me, directly, with no media talking heads between us. Thank you so much for your time and support, Friend. Sincerely, Speaker of the House, Mike Johnson P.S. I love this country and I'm deeply grateful for the opportunity to serve. But Team Johnson can't save America from the radical left and turn things around without the help of patriots like you. That's why I hope and pray that we can count on your support. | | | Paid for by Mike Johnson for Louisiana | Defend the Constitution 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314 |

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Rents are rising like a hot air balloon, and housing prices are out of sight for too many Americans. Here’s what we can do about it.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Housing feels unaffordable because it IS unaffordable.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1893%2E4032634%2EdVwyYp)
---
Let’s start with a basic fact: Housing feels unaffordable because it is unaffordable. From 2020 to 2021, rent in Massachusetts jumped by a whopping 21%. The average home sale price in the same two years increased by nearly 30%. And housing is now the single largest contributor to inflation. It's little wonder that when I meet with constituents from Boston to Pittsfield to the Cape, often the first thing I hear is that the cost of housing is just too high. And when I ask employers their biggest challenge, many mention that they can’t find workers or have trouble attracting top talent because of high housing prices. [**So what can we do to lower costs? I’ll lay out my thoughts below. But first, please add your name to let me know you agree that our government needs to tackle the skyrocketing cost of housing across our country. It’s important that we tackle this issue as a strong movement — and I’d be honored to have you on board.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-housing/?source=EMZ18W_HOU_E_20240111_V1S1&t=8&akid=1893%2E4032634%2EdVwyYp) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-housing/?source=EMZ18W_HOU_E_20240111_V1S1&t=9&akid=1893%2E4032634%2EdVwyYp)
---
For starters, we need to increase supply. We need to build more housing. It’s plain-old Econ 101.
Here in Massachusetts, we are lucky to have a governor who has made it her priority to address the housing crisis head-on. Last fall, Governor Maura Healey introduced the Affordable Homes Act, a set of bold policy proposals to boost the supply of housing and drive down housing costs.
But our Commonwealth can’t tackle this issue all on our own. **It’s time for the federal government to step up and take a bigger role in increasing housing supply.**
We can use money from my 15% minimum corporate tax on billionaire corporations. And for less than 5% of the annual defense budget, we could create a fund that year after year could be used to increase and upgrade the supply of housing nationwide. **I’ll keep fighting for a bill to inject over $40 billion a year into the construction of affordable homes.**
Now, there’s another piece of this we need to address: the increasing power of corporate landlords to squeeze renters.
Since the Great Recession, institutional investors have bought up hundreds of thousands of single-family homes, hoovering up a significant chunk of the existing housing supply. By 2030, these big, Wall Street firms are expected to own as much as 40% of all single-family rental homes.
Once their power is entrenched, there’s little stopping corporate landlords from squeezing families for profits. In communities across the country, institutional investors have hiked rents by double digit margins and jacked up fees, all while letting homes fall apart.
Meaningfully addressing the Wall Street investor problem will require Congress to pass legislation. And Republicans have refused to support investments on the scale of what’s needed. But here there’s hope for more urgent action. **I’ve called on the Biden Administration to use its authority to deliver immediate relief to renters, both from high costs and greedy investors. In response to my call, President Biden revealed a series of federal agency actions and a Blueprint for a Tenant Bill of Rights earlier this year.**
**Big problems require big solutions, and solving the housing crisis will require creative solutions and persistence from all levels of government — along with a strong grassroots movement demanding action.**
**I’m running for re-election this year to stay in the fight for the bold reforms we need, from housing to child care to climate change and beyond.**
[**Please add your name to let me know you agree with this plan to start to tackle this critical issue. Affordable housing is a human right, and we need to raise our voices on this issue and put our government on the side of working families.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-housing/?source=EMZ18W_HOU_E_20240111_V1S1&t=10&akid=1893%2E4032634%2EdVwyYp)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

Dear Peter,
I believe we are standing on the cusp of a historic victory.
Why? Because we are running against the weakest candidates in American history, and the opportunity for change has never been more promising.
Trump and Biden have had their time in the Oval Office. Voters overwhelmingly express a desire for another option in this election. President Biden supporters admit their vote is driven more by fear of Trump's supposed threat to democracy than by genuine belief in his vision.
So in that sense, I've never met a real "Biden voter," only someone choosing the perceived lesser of two evils.
Right now, polls indicate that **I am outperforming both candidates** among Americans under 45 years old. I am leading by 10 points among Americans under 35. And in key battleground states, my average stands at an impressive 24%, **putting me within striking distance of victory**.
**_If we can pull 5% from each of our opponents to get to 34% ... we win._**
---
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=victory_1_11_24_email_1_1_nd&n=4)
---
[With your continued support, we can turn these promising numbers into tangible success.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=victory_1_11_24_email_1_1_nd&n=5)
Remarkably, our campaign's progress so far has been achieved with minimal expenditure compared to the substantial resources of our opponents.
Whenever Americans get to know me beyond the misrepresentations propagated by mainstream media, we see remarkable conversions and support. Our grassroots strategy leveraging new media to reach the electorate is working.
Your generosity will enable us to reach a wider audience, share our message of hope, and dispel the unfair narrative surrounding our campaign.
**We need 100% participation from individuals like you who believe in our cause and understand the urgency of this moment.**
[Join us in making history.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=victory_1_11_24_email_1_1_nd&n=6) **Your contribution today will help us secure victory and bring about the change our nation so desperately needs.**
Together, we can restore integrity, progress, and prosperity to our great country.
Thank you for your unwavering support.
| |

Sincerely,
Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

I don’t regret it.| | | Just about a year ago, I challenged Mitch McConnell for Senate Republican leader.

People thought I was too brazen; some even thought my political career would end. Well, I’m still here, aren’t I?

You see, we work for you, not special interest groups in Washington. I watched as Mitch gave up on our conservative values to please Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, and his Establishment friends in DC.

I don't regret it one bit. It's time Washington CHANGED, Peter.

It's important to me that I'm working in your interests, so tell me... **[Are you happy I challenged Mitch McConnell for Senate Republican Leader?](http://links.voterickscott.com/u/click?_t=24d1692d4ad14657a18af9ad6ea13243&_m=0751756aa22e4132ab2c8bdd3b7add1c&_e=stbTeTg9rzViOp_QuZbz6vuwx-kIZyjNaByR8KfS447r7cujtW5p6JzWaDSu9mEUgez9H24Oyn3N_yblksG-QeXU9wfRFJWq6EMx_Nll35sLjqZR-waW2B5-LYHSedU53wCkSQ7ZKRZIYLVFoQEenQ7tvOne5uwf1Oni3uK_7hp7X1RF700On2TCmwYAiMj-lc4es4e0yoic3NRydtzyv_OrupEyZ6JU08c_z2Efess6GDxqpuUl6M1nP0O5jiYLU7Wfa3m18x2lDDSoOXLS8UGb4ch1nYJ2ssrGUt7rqAVekWQwEGUJ-Z9grDImAhjq6P5O7Lw8hzua8OJjwXrZhZ1EkDkK7fAkGqFVJ1YcP1ZD5VP6tha7WdfBH36LGYyu)**
